title: Boundary shape controls the stress distribution in two-component elastic materials
summary: We investigate how the shape and arrangement of high-stiffness regions govern stress redistribution in two-component triangular elastic spring networks subjected to spatially correlated and uncorrelated random prestress. We compare boundary roughness, partitioning into disconnected regions, and graded transitions between regions of different stiffness. Our simulations identify interface bonds as channels for energy transfer: increasing their number provides additional transfer paths and reduces stress concentration in mechanically rigid regimes, while offering little benefit in compliant subnetworks. This is analogous to defects in naturally occurring crystal structures, where the defects themselves isolate stress. At a fixed fraction of high-stiffness material, partitioning reduces stress concentration for both correlated and uncorrelated prestress. The benefit diminishes with further subdivision as the number of interface bonds becomes comparable to the number of interior nodes. Stress reduction, however, depends on the spatial correlations of the imposed prestress: random prestress generally yields a stronger effect, though the difference diminishes in some regimes. Graded interfaces further reduce peak stress by distributing the stiffness transition over a broader region. Together, these results suggest design strategies based on increasing interface area, matching subdivision scale to prestress correlations, and grading stiffness transitions. This minimal framework identifies how internal structure controls energy transfer and stress redistribution, suggesting design principles for mechanical robustness under both internal and external loading.

AI.tldr: 该文研究双组分三角弹性弹簧网络中高刚度区域的形状与排列如何控制随机预应力下的应力重分布，并提出通过界面工程提升力学稳健性的设计原则。
AI.motivation: 理解内部结构如何控制能量传递与应力重分布，对于设计在内部预应力和外部载荷下均保持稳健的力学材料具有重要意义。
AI.method: 构建双组分三角弹性弹簧网络，施加空间相关与不相关随机预应力，比较边界粗糙度、高刚度区域分割为不连通区域以及刚度渐变过渡三种结构；通过模拟分析界面键、分区尺度和预应力空间相关性对应力集中的影响。
AI.result: 界面键充当能量传递通道：增加界面键可提供更多传递路径并降低刚性区域应力集中，但在柔性子网络中收益很小，类似晶体缺陷对应力的隔离作用。固定高刚度材料比例时，分区可降低相关与不相关预应力下的应力集中，但过度细分后收益递减，因为界面键数量接近内部节点数。随机预应力通常带来更强应力降低效果，但在某些区域差异减小。渐变界面通过拓宽刚度过渡区进一步降低峰值应力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明可依据增加界面面积、使分区尺度匹配预应力空间相关性、采用刚度渐变过渡等策略进行设计；该最小框架揭示了内部结构对能量传递和应力重分布的控制，为内外载荷下的机械稳健性提供设计原则。

title: Existence and Absence of Spin-Glass Phases on Migdal--Kadanoff Hierarchical Lattices: A Complete Classification
summary: We consider the Ising spin-glass model on Migdal--Kadanoff (MK) hierarchical lattices, characterized by the fractal dimension $d=1+\log s/\log b$, where $s$ and $b$ denote the number of parallel branches and the number of bonds in series within each branch, respectively. For independent Gaussian couplings, we rigorously establish a necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of finite-temperature spin-glass order for arbitrary integers $b,s\ge2$. We prove that a finite-temperature spin-glass phase exists whenever \[ \frac{b}{\sqrt{s}} \left( \frac{b\sqrt{s(s-1)}}{bs-1} \right)^{s-1}<1. \] In particular, this condition holds for all three-dimensional MK hierarchical lattices ($d=3$, or equivalently $s=b^2$), regardless of the choice of $b$. Conversely, we prove the absence of finite-temperature spin-glass order for fractal dimensions $d<1+\log17/\log6\approx2.58$, as well as in the large-$b$ limit for any fixed $d<3$. In the intermediate regime $1+\log17/\log6\le d<3$, we provide a finite-step procedure to determine the presence or absence of spin-glass order, which depends on $b$ and $s$. Our results provide a complete characterization of finite-temperature spin-glass order on MK hierarchical lattices.

AI.tldr: 该文严格刻画了独立高斯耦合 Ising 自旋玻璃在 Migdal--Kadanoff 分级格上的有限温度自旋玻璃序，给出任意 b,s≥2 的充要条件，并覆盖三维、低维及中间维数情形。
AI.motivation: Migdal--Kadanoff 分级格具有可重整化结构，是研究自旋玻璃相变与维数依赖性的重要模型；作者旨在给出有限温度自旋玻璃序的完整、严格判据。
AI.method: 考虑分形维数 d=1+log s/log b 的 MK 格，其中 s 为平行分支数、b 为每支串联键数；对独立高斯耦合进行严格分析，导出有限温度自旋玻璃序存在的充要条件，并对中间维数区间构造有限步判定程序。
AI.result: 证明有限温度自旋玻璃相存在当且仅当 b/√s · (b√(s(s-1))/(bs-1))^(s-1)<1。由此，所有三维 MK 格（d=3，即 s=b^2）无论 b 如何均存在自旋玻璃序；当 d<1+log17/log6≈2.58 时不存在，且对任意固定 d<3 的大 b 极限也不存在。在 1+log17/log6≤d<3 的中间区间，给出依赖 b,s 的有限步判定方法。
AI.conclusion: 文章完整表征了 MK 分级格上 Ising 自旋玻璃的有限温度自旋玻璃序：三维必存在、低维必不存在，中间维数由显式有限步判据决定。

title: Generalization properties of the token perceptron: the role of embedding and vocabulary
summary: Large language models are trained to predict tokens from a finite vocabulary, each represented by a vector in a $d$-dimensional embedding space. Therefore, token prediction is a classification problem whose classes have a geometry determined by the embedding. We study how this geometry affects learning in a minimal solvable model: a linear predictor that maps a sequence of $N$ embedded tokens to a $d$-dimensional output through one $d\times d$ matrix per position, trained in the teacher--student setting. We call this the \textit{token perceptron}. We compute its generalization error with the replica method, taking $N\to\infty$ at fixed number of examples per position $\alpha=P/N$ and keeping $d$ and the vocabulary size $D$ finite. As a first reference case, we consider continuous embeddings on the sphere, which isolate the role of the embedding dimension. The natural load is then $\alpha/d$, and for $d>1$ a normalized label fixes the direction of the teacher output, so the problem becomes a noiseless regression: the teacher is recovered exactly above $\alpha_{\rm rec}=d^2/(d-1)$, and spherical cross-entropy reaches this threshold at large inverse temperature. In the same setting the storage capacity of random associations scales as $d^2$ for margins $O(1/\sqrt{d})$. We then turn to vocabulary embeddings, where a label only identifies the Voronoi cell of the teacher output, so that each example imposes inequalities rather than equations, as in the classical perceptron. We compute the Bayes-optimal error for a given embedding matrix through an approximate spectral closure and show that the optimal learner first resolves the directions in which the vocabulary has the largest variance, even when the teacher is isotropic.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并解析 token perceptron，研究 token 嵌入几何如何影响线性 token 预测的学习与泛化。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型从有限词表中预测 token，而每个 token 由 d 维嵌入向量表示，因此 token 预测本质上是类别几何由嵌入决定的分类问题；需要理解该几何对学习的影响。
AI.method: 构建最小可解模型：每个位置用一个 d×d 矩阵将 N 个嵌入 token 的序列线性映射到 d 维输出；在 teacher-student 设定下用复制法计算泛化误差，取 N→∞、每位置样本数 α=P/N 固定，并保持 d 与词表大小 D 有限；先分析球面连续嵌入，再分析词表嵌入（标签仅确定 teacher 输出的 Voronoi 胞，形成不等式约束），并通过近似谱闭包计算给定嵌入矩阵的 Bayes 最优误差。
AI.result: 连续球面嵌入下自然负载为 α/d；d>1 时归一化标签固定 teacher 输出方向，问题化为无噪声回归，teacher 在 α_rec=d^2/(d-1) 以上被精确恢复，球面交叉熵在大逆温度下达到该阈值；随机关联的存储容量在 margin 为 O(1/√d) 时按 d^2 缩放。词表嵌入下，最优学习器即使面对各向同性 teacher，也先分辨词表方差最大的方向。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入几何决定 token 预测的学习难度与样本效率；连续嵌入给出精确恢复阈值和 d^2 存储容量，词表嵌入因 Voronoi 不等式约束呈现不同机制，最优学习优先利用高方差方向。

title: First- and Second-Order Electron Position Correlators Reveal Topological Phase Transitions
summary: The theory of conventional critical phenomena is built around the concepts of fluctuations and correlators of local observables. Here, we show that topological phase transitions can also be characterized through spatial and temporal two-point correlation functions associated with fluctuations of the electronic position operator. The key object is the antisymmetric part of the position-position correlation function, which yields the Chern number in the equal-time and equal-space limit. When the system is translationally invariant in space or time (the latter case corresponding to an equilibrium condition), these two-point correlators reduce to one-variable functions of the remaining variable. Remarkably, these functions are both reminiscent of critical behaviour, including divergent correlation times and lengths signalling the phase transitions. Away from these conditions, namely in non-periodic systems or genuinely dynamical processes, criticality is instead better captured by higher-order Chern-Chern correlators constructed from local or dynamical markers obtained as coincident-point limits of the position correlators. These higher-order Chern-Chern correlators can be seen as double Levi-Civita contractions of second-order position correlators, selecting the antisymmetric sector in each index pair. We substantiate this framework through numerical simulations and analytic calculations. Our results establish a general correlator-based description of topological phase transitions, applicable to crystalline, noncrystalline, equilibrium, and dynamical systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用电子位置算符涨落的时空两点关联函数描述拓扑相变：位置-位置关联函数的反对称部分在等时等空极限给出Chern数；在空间或时间平移不变（后者为平衡）时退化为单变量临界型关联，非周期或动力学情形则用高阶Chern-Chern关联子刻画临界性。
AI.motivation: 传统临界现象理论以局域可观测量的涨落和关联子为核心，而拓扑相变通常缺乏类似的局域关联函数描述；作者希望建立统一的、基于关联函数的拓扑相变框架。
AI.method: 定义位置-位置两点关联函数并提取其反对称部分，在等时等空极限计算Chern数；在空间/时间平移不变条件下将关联函数降为单变量函数，分析相关长度和关联时间的发散；对非周期系统和真实动力学过程，用重合点极限得到的局部或动力学标记构造高阶Chern-Chern关联子，其可视为二阶位置关联子的双Levi-Civita收缩并逐指标对选择反对称扇区；结合数值模拟与解析计算验证。
AI.result: 位置关联函数反对称部分的等时等空极限可给出Chern数；平移不变或平衡条件下的降维关联函数呈现临界行为，相关长度/时间发散可标记相变；高阶Chern-Chern关联子能更好描述非周期和动力学系统中的临界性；数值与解析结果支持该框架。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了通用的基于关联子的拓扑相变描述，可适用于晶体、非晶体、平衡和非平衡动力学系统。

title: Optical signatures of Rashba--Dresselhaus coupling across Franz--Keldysh and Landau regimes in two-dimensional semiconductors
summary: We develop a unified theory of the interband optical response of a two-dimensional semiconductor with simultaneous Rashba and Dresselhaus spin-orbit couplings in electric and magnetic fields. In crossed fields, the in-plane electric field generates an effective spin-orbit drift field that modifies the Landau spectrum and spinor states, while at zero magnetic field the problem maps onto Landau--Zener spin dynamics.At zero external fields, the total joint density of states above the band gap remains unchanged, while characteristic subgap structures appear. Pure Rashba coupling produces an inverse square root singularity, whereas a finite Dresselhaus term gives a step and a logarithmic peak, allowing the two couplings to be distinguished optically. At zero magnetic field, the Franz--Keldysh response shows a crossover from diabatic to adiabatic spin dynamics as the electric field is reduced. In the weak-field Rashba regime, the field-free singularity becomes a finite peak whose height scales as $\mathcal E^{-1/3}$ and whose position approaches $E_g-E_{\rm SO}$, providing a direct measure of the Rashba energy. In a perpendicular magnetic field, spin-orbit coupling shifts and splits the Landau absorption lines and produces anticrossings without changing their total weights. The Rashba splitting changes from a $\sqrt{B}$ dependence at weak fields to a linear dependence at strong fields. Finally, in crossed electric and magnetic fields, the electric field broadens the Landau lines and drives a continuous crossover toward the Franz--Keldysh regime, while spin-orbit coupling produces opposite shifts and different widths for the two members of each doublet.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个统一理论，用于描述同时具有Rashba和Dresselhaus自旋轨道耦合的二维半导体在电场和磁场中的带间光学响应。
AI.motivation: 现有工作缺乏对Rashba与Dresselhaus自旋轨道耦合、电场和磁场共同作用下二维半导体带间光学响应的统一描述，尤其是如何通过光学谱区分两种自旋轨道耦合及探测Rashba能量。
AI.method: 基于二维半导体中同时存在的Rashba和Dresselhaus自旋轨道耦合，在电场与磁场下求解Landau能谱、自旋子态和带间光学响应；在交叉场中将面内电场视为有效自旋轨道漂移场，并将零磁场问题映射为Landau-Zener自旋动力学。
AI.result: 零外场下带隙以上总联合态密度不变但出现子带隙结构：纯Rashba耦合给出反平方根奇异性，有限Dresselhaus项给出台阶和对数峰，从而可在光学上区分二者。零磁场Franz-Keldysh响应随电场降低呈现从绝热到非绝热自旋动力学的交叉；弱场Rashba区无场奇异性变为有限峰，峰高按电场强度的负三分之一幂标度，峰位趋近于禁带宽度减自旋轨道能量，可直接测量Rashba能量。垂直磁场中自旋轨道耦合使Landau吸收线移动和劈裂并产生反交叉但不改变总权重；Rashba劈裂在弱场按磁场的平方根依赖、强场转为线性依赖。交叉电磁场中电场展宽Landau线并驱动向Franz-Keldysh区域的连续交叉，自旋轨道耦合使每个双重态的两个成员产生相反移动和不同线宽。
AI.conclusion: 该统一理论给出了二维半导体中Rashba和Dresselhaus自旋轨道耦合在电场、磁场及交叉场下带间光学响应的完整图景，并提供了通过光学谱区分自旋轨道耦合类型、探测Rashba能量以及识别Landau能级劈裂和场致交叉的实验判据。

title: Heat current and noise in a point-like junction between normal metal and fractional quantum hall edge state with $\nu = 1/3$
summary: In this study, we investigate heat current correlations between two edge states coupled through a constriction in the fractional quantum Hall regime at filling factor $\nu = 1/3$. This configuration allows us to map the system onto an interacting Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid with a local impurity, where the interaction parameter takes the value $\kappa = 1/2$. This specific parameter value enables the application of the refermionization method. By solving the refermionized Hamiltonian, we compute the heat current and evaluate the finite-frequency heat auto- and cross-correlation functions. Our results reveal asymmetric behavior with frequency, corresponding to absorption and emission noise, respectively. Furthermore, we examine several limiting cases, including low- and high-temperature limits as well as strong- and weak-backscattering regimes. In the weak backscattering regime, the Lorenz number approaches $4L_0$ at high voltage, suggesting a rescaling of the Wiedemann-Franz law due to interactions. A detailed study of the heat current fluctuations has made it possible to identify and derive expressions for the dominant contribution in the various regimes of interest, and to reveal the predominance of partition noise.

AI.tldr: 研究了分数量子霍尔 ν=1/3 体系中通过收缩耦合的两条边缘态之间的热流关联，并利用 κ=1/2 的相互作用 Tomonaga-Luttinger 液体模型与再费米化方法计算有限频率热噪声。
AI.motivation: 明确分数量子霍尔边缘态在局域杂质/收缩耦合下的热输运涨落特性，尤其是相互作用对热流关联、噪声类型及 Wiedemann-Franz 定律的影响。
AI.method: 将系统映射为带局域杂质的相互作用 Tomonaga-Luttinger 液体，取相互作用参数 κ=1/2 以应用再费米化方法；求解再费米化哈密顿量，计算热流及有限频率热自相关和交叉关联函数，并分析低/高温、强/弱背散射等极限。
AI.result: 热流关联随频率呈不对称行为，分别对应吸收噪声与发射噪声；在弱背散射区，高电压下 Lorenz 数趋近 4L0，表明相互作用导致 Wiedemann-Franz 定律的重标度；不同区域的主导热流涨落贡献被识别并给出表达式，且分区噪声占主导。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了分数量子霍尔 ν=1/3 边缘态中相互作用杂质对热流涨落的关键作用，给出了可区分的吸收/发射噪声特征、修正的 Wiedemann-Franz 关系和分区噪声主导机制。

title: Visualization of Single Spin-chain Propagation using Bragg Coherent Diffraction Imaging
summary: Domain wall dynamics and their manipulation in finite-size systems serve as a promising platform for beyond Moore's law applications. Yet, the imaging techniques to track their motion in real-space and time are limited. Here, we use magnetic domain walls formed in permalloy artificial square lattice to demonstrate that single-shot Bragg coherent diffraction imaging (BCDI) is a powerful approach for this purpose. Our BCDI reconstructed images revealed milliseconds time-scale dynamics of the antiphase magnetic domain walls traveling through an antiferromagnetically ordered sample.

AI.tldr: 利用坡莫合金人工方阵中的磁畴壁，证明单次曝光布拉格相干衍射成像（BCDI）可在实空间和时间内追踪有限尺寸体系中的畴壁运动。
AI.motivation: 有限尺寸体系中的畴壁动力学对后摩尔时代应用很重要，但现有实空间、时间分辨成像手段有限。
AI.method: 在坡莫合金人工方阵中形成磁畴壁，采用单次曝光BCDI进行成像，并重建反相磁畴壁在反铁磁有序样品中传播的过程。
AI.result: BCDI重建图像揭示了反相磁畴壁穿越反铁磁有序样品的毫秒时间尺度动力学。
AI.conclusion: 单次曝光BCDI是研究有限尺寸体系中磁畴壁实空间、时间分辨动力学的有力方法。

title: Dipole chains of Bloch point singularities revealed by X-ray magnetic tomography
summary: Bloch point singularities play an important role in magnetic systems, mediating changes in topology in three dimensional configurations. However, until now they have only been observed as isolated objects or as part of individual topological textures. Here we present the experimental observation of a 1D dipole chain of Bloch points in an anisotropic chiral magnet using soft X-ray magnetic vector tomography. We identify that the chain of Bloch point singularities lies along a boundary between regions of opposite chirality and that neighbouring Bloch and anti-Bloch points are stable at separations down to 60 nm. The stability of the Bloch points is determined to be closely related to the surrounding topology of the magnetisation configuration and a threshold separation for the spontaneous annihilation of Bloch point-anti-Bloch point pairs within chiral domain walls is identified to be approximately 90 nm in distance. This observation of a chain of Bloch points and the insight into their stability, offers a route to explore the correlative behaviour of such topological point defects. The behaviour and control of such point defects is of relevance for the control of 3D magnetisation configurations, and provides a new route towards the creation of correlated configurations of singularities in a magnetic system.

AI.tldr: 利用软X射线磁矢量层析在反对称手性磁体中首次观测到由Bloch点与反Bloch点组成的一维偶极链，并揭示其稳定性与周围磁化拓扑密切相关。
AI.motivation: Bloch点奇异在磁系统中可介导三维拓扑变化，但此前仅以孤立对象或单个拓扑织构的一部分被观测，缺乏对多个Bloch点关联行为及稳定性的认识。
AI.method: 在 anisotropic chiral magnet 中使用 soft X-ray magnetic vector tomography 对三维磁化矢量进行成像，识别Bloch点/反Bloch点链及其与手性畴壁和相反手性区域边界的关系。
AI.result: 观测到沿相反手性区域边界分布的一维Bloch点偶极链；相邻Bloch点与反Bloch点可稳定至约60 nm间距；其稳定性由周围磁化拓扑决定，并确定手性畴壁内Bloch点-反Bloch点对自发湮灭的阈值间距约为90 nm。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了磁性系统中一维Bloch点链的观测及其稳定性机制，为研究拓扑点缺陷的关联行为、控制三维磁化构型以及构建关联奇异构型提供了新途径。

title: The Extended Diode Equation
summary: For more than 75 years, the p-n junction current-voltage characteristic has been derived by treating majority carriers as an inert background and conflating the junction voltage with the applied bias. Here we show that the base electric field, generated by the coupling of excess majority and minority carriers, fundamentally alters the internal potential distribution. This self-consistent framework yields a closed-form extended diode equation that reproduces the high-injection roll-off without invoking an external series resistance, thereby eliminating an empirical patch that has persisted in the classical theory.

AI.tldr: 提出自洽的扩展二极管方程，揭示过剩多数与少数载流子耦合产生的基区电场会改变p-n结内部电势分布，并在不引入外部串联电阻的情况下解释高注入roll-off。
AI.motivation: 传统p-n结电流-电压理论将多数载流子视为惰性背景，并把结电压与外加偏压混为一谈，导致高注入行为需依赖经验性串联电阻修补。
AI.method: 建立考虑过剩多数载流子与少数载流子耦合所产生基区电场的自洽框架，重新求解内部电势分布，并推导闭式扩展二极管方程。
AI.result: 所得扩展二极管方程可复现高注入roll-off，且无需引入外部串联电阻。
AI.conclusion: 基区电场对p-n结内部电势分布具有根本影响；该自洽理论消除了经典二极管理论中长期存在的经验性修正。

title: A Self-Consistent Two-Carrier Drift-Diffusion Framework for p-n Junctions: Extended Diode Equation, Power Dissipation, and Base Transit Time
summary: The classical theory of p-n junctions derives the current-voltage characteristic from minority-carrier diffusion alone: majority carriers are treated as an inert background, the quasi-neutral base as field-free, and the junction voltage as equal to the applied bias. These premises fail together under high bias and high-level injection, where the observed current roll-off is reproduced only by appending an empirical series resistance outside the junction physics. Here we develop a self-consistent two-carrier drift-diffusion framework that introduces no assumption beyond the classical ones. Excess majority carriers are shown to be electrostatically forced transport participants: the ambipolar diffusion equation, closed by exact two-sided boundary conditions, yields a unified excess-carrier profile. The resulting base field separates into an ohmic and a Dember component, and all four current components follow in closed form, their sum being position independent. At device level the framework closes into an extended diode equation that contains the Shockley equation as its low-injection, long-base limit and reproduces the n=2 roll-off intrinsically. The junction voltage emerges as a self-limiting drop confined to the space-charge region and separated from the applied bias by exact base drops. Two device-level corrections are quantified: at high current, 75-90% of the dissipation migrates from the junction into the quasi-neutral base, and field-assisted acceleration shortens the base transit time by up to a factor of six. Three parameter-free predictions follow: a universal ideality-factor crossover that passes through 3/2 when the boundary excess equals the doping, a high-injection onset voltage that scales as 119 mV per decade of doping, and a geometry factor that survives into high injection.

AI.tldr: 该文建立无额外假设的自洽双载流子漂移-扩散框架，解释p-n结在高偏压/高注入下的电流滚降，并将经典Shockley方程作为低注入长基区极限，无需外加经验串联电阻。
AI.motivation: 经典p-n结理论仅由少子扩散推导I-V特性，把多子视为惰性背景、准中性基区视为无场、结电压等于外加偏压；这些前提在高偏压和高注入下同时失效，实验电流滚降只能靠经验串联电阻修补。
AI.method: 作者在经典假设之外不引入新假设，建立双载流子漂移-扩散框架：由双侧精确边界条件闭合双极扩散方程，得到统一过剩载流子分布；基区电场分解为欧姆分量和Dember分量，四个电流分量均给出闭式表达且总和与位置无关；器件层面导出扩展二极管方程，包含Shockley低注入长基区极限并内禀再现n=2滚降；结电压成为限制在空间电荷区的自限压降，并由精确基区压降与外加偏压分离。
AI.result: 高电流下75-90%的耗散从结区迁移到准中性基区，场助加速使基区渡越时间最多缩短6倍；给出三个无参数预测：当边界过剩载流子等于掺杂时普适理想因子交叉经过3/2，高注入起始电压按每十倍掺杂119 mV缩放，以及几何因子可延续到高注入区。
AI.conclusion: 该框架用自洽物理机制替代经验串联电阻，统一描述低注入到高注入的p-n结行为，并给出可检验的器件级修正与无参数预测。

title: Material criteria for angular-momentum transfer from twisted photons to photoelectrons
summary: We study the material requirements for transferring the total-angular-momentum (TAM) projection of a twisted photon to the orbital angular momentum (OAM) of a photoelectron emitted from an $n$-type semiconductor surface. Within a single-valley effective-mass model of surface photoemission, we calculate OAM-resolved spectra for GaAs, InSb, $\mathrm{InAs}_{0.34}\mathrm{Sb}_{0.66}$, and $\mathrm{Hg}_{0.76}\mathrm{Cd}_{0.24}\mathrm{Te}$ irradiated by twisted photons with Laguerre--Gaussian--like momentum profile. The OAM transfer is characterized by the mean electron OAM, its root-mean-squared width, and the fraction of electrons with OAM-projection equal to the photon TAM-projection. Efficient transfer requires the transverse momentum of the conduction electron to be much smaller than the transverse momentum width of the photon, which favors low temperatures, small conduction-band effective masses, and shallow donor levels. GaAs is less favorable within the present model because of its larger effective mass and deeper donor levels. We also discuss the demanding photon-wave packet parameters, possible extensions to Dirac and Weyl semimetals, and post-emission OAM selection. Although the generation of vortex electrons with a vanishing OAM uncertainty via photoemission seems challenging, we argue that it is still possible to generate single-electron vortex states with a finite OAM dispersion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究将扭曲光子的总角动量投影转移为n型半导体表面光电子轨道角动量的材料条件。
AI.motivation: 探索扭曲光子TAM到光电子OAM的高效转移，并评估不同半导体材料的适用性。
AI.method: 采用单谷有效质量表面光发射模型，对GaAs、InSb、InAs0.34Sb0.66和Hg0.76Cd0.24Te在类拉盖尔-高斯扭曲光子照射下的OAM分辨谱进行计算，并用平均OAM、均方根宽度及OAM投影等于光子TAM投影的电子比例表征转移效果。
AI.result: 高效转移要求导电子横向动量远小于光子横向动量宽度，因而有利于低温、小导带有效质量和浅施主能级；GaAs因有效质量较大且施主能级较深而不利。文中还讨论了光子波包参数、向Dirac/Weyl半金属的扩展及发射后OAM选择。
AI.conclusion: 通过光发射产生OAM不确定度为零的涡旋电子虽有挑战，但仍可能生成具有有限OAM色散的单电子涡旋态。

title: Magnonic time crystal with lasing coherence
summary: Discrete time crystals (DTC) can respond at an integer multiple of the drive period. Internal order-parameter measurements have advanced studies of this novel non-equilibrium phase of matter; however, turning this order into highly coherent, externally accessible radiation remains challenging: pump-driven nonlinear processes must supply sufficient gain to compensate dissipation while preserving subharmonic stability. Here we realize a room-temperature magnonic time crystal (MTC) with radiation of lasing coherence using a pump-induced magnon mode in yttrium iron garnet. A microwave beat drive produces robust period doubling over a finite parameter range, with spectral signatures of higher-order MTC at stronger driving. The emitted field exhibits linewidth narrowing to 260.0 Hz and a first-order correlation decay time of $995 \mu s$. Our model links this response to three-magnon confluence, yields a stability region consistent with experiment and predicts a possible transition to chaos. We further map the complex temporal dynamics into frequency-resolved nonlinear features for reservoir computing. These results bridge time-crystalline order and nonlinear information processing through intrinsic magnon-magnon interactions and lasing coherence.

AI.tldr: 该文在室温钇铁石榴石中利用泵浦诱导磁振子模式实现磁振子时间晶体，并观测到具有激光相干性的外部辐射；微波拍频驱动产生稳健的倍周期响应，线宽窄至260.0 Hz，一阶关联衰减时间达995 μs。
AI.motivation: 时间晶体内部序参量测量已较成熟，但如何将这种序转化为高度相干、可外部访问的辐射仍困难：泵浦驱动的非线性过程需提供足够增益以补偿耗散，同时保持亚谐稳定性。
AI.method: 在YIG中通过泵浦诱导磁振子模式构建室温磁振子时间晶体；采用微波拍频驱动，测量辐射频谱与一阶相干性，并建立基于三磁振子汇合的非线性模型解释周期倍增、稳定性区域及可能的混沌转变；进一步将复杂时序动力学映射为频率分辨非线性特征用于储备池计算。
AI.result: 实验观察到有限参数范围内的稳健倍周期，强驱动下出现高阶MTC谱特征；辐射线宽收窄至260.0 Hz，一阶关联衰减时间为995 μs；模型给出的稳定区与实验一致，并预测可能向混沌转变；时间动力学可映射为频率分辨非线性特征并用于储备池计算。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过本征磁振子-磁振子相互作用和激光相干性，将时间晶体序与非线性信息处理联系起来，为相干辐射型时间晶体及基于MTC的非线性计算提供途径。

title: Nonlocal Thermoelectric Transport in Degenerate Electron Systems
summary: When the characteristic length scales of transport become comparable to the carrier mean free path, the local constitutive description breaks down. We develop the Flux Derivative Formalism (FDF), a kinetic framework that provides a systematic route from the Boltzmann equation to nonlocal constitutive equations. We use it to derive coupled equations for charge and heat transport in isotropic electronic systems, together with boundary conditions derived consistently within this approach, yielding a closed macroscopic description that can be applied to complex geometries without solving the full Boltzmann problem. The explicit transport coefficients are derived for degenerate electronic systems within the Callaway model. A central result is that varying the relative strength of resistive and momentum-conserving collisions changes the transport coefficients but not the non-local constitutive structure, providing a continuous description from resistive-dominated transport to the collective hydrodynamic limit. The electronic heat equation takes a Guyer-Krumhansl form, whose predictions are validated against size-dependent thermal-transport measurements in Cu and Ni. For coupled thermoelectric transport, the resulting boundary-value problem determines the complete geometry-dependent transport matrix. Comparison with spatially resolved Boltzmann solutions confirms quantitative accuracy down to transverse dimensions comparable to the carrier mean free path. The theory predicts geometry-dependent Seebeck and Peltier coefficients while preserving Onsager reciprocity and the Kelvin relation.

AI.tldr: 提出通量导数形式（FDF），从玻尔兹曼方程系统导出非局域电荷与热输运宏观方程及边界条件，并在退化电子系统和Callaway模型中给出可验证的输运系数。
AI.motivation: 当输运特征尺度与载流子平均自由程相当时，局域本构描述失效，需要无需完全求解玻尔兹曼方程的非局域宏观理论。
AI.method: 建立Flux Derivative Formalism动能框架，从玻尔兹曼方程推导各向同性电子系统的耦合电荷-热输运方程和一致边界条件；在Callaway模型中导出退化电子系统的显式输运系数，热方程呈Guver-Krumhansl形式。
AI.result: 发现阻性碰撞与动量守恒碰撞的相对强度改变输运系数但不改变非局域本构结构，从而实现从阻性主导到集体流体动力学极限的连续描述；热输运预测与Cu、Ni尺寸依赖测量吻合，耦合热电边值问题给出几何依赖的完整输运矩阵，并与空间分辨玻尔兹曼解在横向尺寸接近平均自由程时定量一致；理论预测几何依赖的Seebeck和Peltier系数且保持Onsager互易与Kelvin关系。
AI.conclusion: FDF提供了从动力学理论到闭合宏观非局域本构的通用路线，可在复杂几何中避免求解完整玻尔兹曼问题，并统一描述阻性到流体动力学输运及几何依赖热电响应。

title: Quantum Landau Lifshitz Gilbert equation in ferromagnetic conductors and magnetic insulators
summary: Understanding the microscopic origin of magnetic damping is essential for describing magnetization dynamics in nanoscale magnetic systems. In this work, we develop a microscopic framework to derive Gilbert damping terms from specific interactions in ferromagnetic conductors and magnetic insulators. In ferromagnetic conductors, magnetic damping is dominated by the s d exchange interaction between the localized magnetic moments and the itinerant electrons, which is effectively equivalent to an electronmagnon interaction. From the spin diffusion equation and the spin transfer torque therein, we obtain the corresponding quantum LLG equation. In magnetic insulators, where free electrons are absent, spin phonon interactions become the primary source of the damping.Starting from an effective spin phonon interaction and using linear response theory, we derive a quantum LLG equation with a Gilbert damping tensor analytically. Our results demonstrate that different microscopic interactions lead to qualitatively different structures of magnetic damping. Instead of being described by a universal scalar parameter, Gilbert damping can exhibit spatial dependence and tensorial characteristics determined by the underlying microscopic interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文建立微观框架，从铁磁导体中的s-d交换/电子-磁子相互作用和磁绝缘体中的自旋-声子相互作用出发，推导量子LLG方程及Gilbert阻尼项。
AI.motivation: 理解纳米磁系统中磁阻尼的微观起源，并突破将Gilbert阻尼视为普适标量参数的简化描述。
AI.method: 对铁磁导体，从自旋扩散方程及其中的自旋转移矩出发，将s-d交换等效为电子-磁子相互作用并推导量子LLG方程；对磁绝缘体，从有效自旋-声子相互作用出发，利用线性响应理论解析推导含Gilbert阻尼张量的量子LLG方程。
AI.result: 不同微观相互作用导致定性不同的磁阻尼结构；Gilbert阻尼并非普适标量，而可表现出空间依赖性和张量特征，其形式由底层微观相互作用决定。
AI.conclusion: 磁阻尼的微观机制决定其张量与空间结构，因此需要针对具体材料与相互作用建立非普适的Gilbert阻尼描述。

title: Multifractal Magnons Around Localized Defects
summary: Multifractal wavefunctions fluctuate over a hierarchy of spatial scales, remaining spatially extended while exhibiting strongly nonuniform structure. We show that magnons in otherwise crystalline two-dimensional magnets can exhibit such behavior on mesoscopic scales, without disorder or quasiperiodicity. A localized defect can mix discrete groups of nearly degenerate magnon states in a finite sample, generating multiscale interference patterns and multifractal wavefunctions. We demonstrate this mechanism for both a simple spin defect and topological magnetic skyrmions. Large-scale spin-wave calculations for skyrmions in chiral and frustrated magnets reveal clear multifractal diagnostics over the full accessible range of system sizes of above-gap modes. Crucially, skyrmions make these states experimentally observable by hybridizing them with magnetically active internal deformation modes, which gives a subset of the multifractal states a nonzero magnetic dipole moment. These states can therefore be excited by uniform ac fields and remain distinguishable at realistic frequency resolution, providing a direct route to observing mesoscopic magnon multifractality.

AI.tldr: 晶体二维磁体中的单个局域缺陷可混合近简并磁振子态，无需无序或准周期性即可在介观尺度产生多分形波函数；斯格明子通过将部分多分形态与内部形变模杂化，使其获得非零磁偶极矩并可由均匀交变场激发。
AI.motivation: 多分形波函数通常与无序或准周期结构相关。本文探索在无无序的晶体二维磁体中，磁振子能否在介观尺度表现多分形行为，并解决其实验可观测性问题。
AI.method: 采用理论分析与大规模自旋波计算，研究有限样品中局域缺陷对近简并磁振子态的混合作用；分别考察简单自旋缺陷以及手性和阻挫磁体中的拓扑斯格明子，并使用多分形诊断量分析波函数，同时分析斯格明子与磁性内部形变模的杂化。
AI.result: 局域缺陷可诱导多尺度干涉图样和多分形磁振子波函数。对斯格明子体系，带隙以上模式在可达系统尺寸范围内显示清晰的多分形特征；斯格明子与内部形变模杂化使部分多分形态具有非零磁偶极矩，从而可由均匀交变场激发，并在现实频率分辨率下保持可区分。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种无需无序的介观磁振子多分形机制，并给出通过斯格明子杂化实现直接实验观测的可行路径。

title: Excitonic Stark Response Induced by Quantum Capacitance in van der Waals Heterostructures
summary: Precise electrostatic control in van der Waals heterostructures is commonly described by a geometric capacitor model, which assumes that the internal electric field is fully determined by external gate voltages. Here, we show that this description breaks down in the presence of interfacial charge transfer, where quantum capacitance modifies the internal electrostatics. Using interlayer excitons as local probes, we observe a dipole-dependent energy splitting that persists even when the gate-induced geometric field is nominally canceled. This splitting reflects incomplete cancellation between gate- and carrier-induced fields set by quantum capacitance, while many-body renormalization is largely symmetric with respect to the two opposite dipole orientations, allowing the splitting to provide a direct optical measure of the local chemical potential. Our results reveal the central role of quantum capacitance in interface electrostatics and provide a route to probe it in operando.

AI.tldr: 界面电荷转移会使范德华异质结的几何电容模型失效，量子电容显著改变内部静电；利用层间激子可局域探测偶极依赖能级分裂，并据此光学测量局部化学势。
AI.motivation: 范德华异质结的静电控制通常用几何电容模型描述，即内部电场完全由外栅压决定；但界面电荷转移存在时该假设失效，需要阐明量子电容对内建静电的影响并提供在线探测手段。
AI.method: 以层间激子作为局域探针，测量当栅致几何电场名义上被抵消时仍存在的偶极依赖能量分裂，并分析栅致场与载流子致场的不完全抵消以及多体重整化的对称性。
AI.result: 观察到持续存在的偶极依赖分裂；该分裂源于量子电容设定的栅致场与载流子致场不完全抵消，而多体重整化对两种相反偶极方向近似对称，因此分裂可直接反映局域化学势。
AI.conclusion: 量子电容在界面静电中起核心作用；层间激子提供了一种在操作中探测量子电容和局域化学势的光学途径。

title: Magnetic Anisotropy and Magnetization Dynamics in Si/Ni Multilayers Probed by FMR and VSM Magnetometry
summary: The magnetic anisotropy and magnetization dynamics of sputtered [Si(40~\AA)/Ni($t_{\mathrm{Ni}}$~\AA)]$_{20}$ multilayers were systematically investigated at room temperature using SQUID--VSM magnetometry and angle-dependent ferromagnetic resonance (FMR). Static measurements reveal soft ferromagnetic behaviour in thicker Ni layers and mixed ferromagnetic and superparamagnetic contributions at reduced thicknesses. The saturation magnetization increases toward the bulk Ni value with increasing thickness, consistent with Ni nanocrystallite growth. Magnetic dead-layer analysis yields an interfacial dead-layer thickness of approximately $9$~\AA\ per interface, accounting for the suppressed magnetization in thinner Ni layers. Angle-dependent FMR measurements reveal effective easy-plane magnetic anisotropy, while out-of-plane spectra exhibit additional non-uniform spin-wave modes. The effective magnetization remains lower than the static saturation magnetization, indicating a perpendicular anisotropy contribution that partially compensates the demagnetizing field. Quantitative anisotropy analysis yields an interfacial anisotropy constant of $K_S = +0.17~\mathrm{erg\,cm^{-2}}$, favouring perpendicular magnetization, and a volume anisotropy constant of $K_V = -1.23 \times 10^6~\mathrm{erg\,cm^{-3}}$, favouring in-plane alignment, with an extrapolated anisotropy crossover thickness of $t_c \approx 27$~\AA. Increasing FMR line-shape asymmetry with decreasing Ni thickness is consistent with enhanced interfacial roughness. These findings highlight the competing interfacial and volume anisotropies and the importance of Ni thickness and interface quality in tailoring Si/Ni multilayers for silicon-compatible spintronic applications.

AI.tldr: 系统研究了室温下溅射[Si(40 Å)/Ni(t_Ni Å)]20多层膜的磁各向异性与磁化动力学，揭示界面与体积各向异性的竞争及Ni厚度和界面质量的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 为面向硅兼容自旋电子学应用优化Si/Ni多层膜，需要理解Ni厚度、界面死层和界面粗糙度如何调控其静态磁性、有效各向异性和FMR动力学。
AI.method: 采用SQUID-VSM磁强计和角度依赖铁磁共振（FMR）在室温下表征溅射[Si(40 Å)/Ni(t_Ni Å)]20多层膜的静态磁性与磁化动力学。
AI.result: 较厚Ni层呈软铁磁行为，较薄层表现为铁磁与超顺磁贡献混合；饱和磁化随Ni厚度增加趋近块体Ni，界面死层约9 Å/界面。角度FMR显示有效易面各向异性，面外谱出现非均匀自旋波模；有效磁化低于静态饱和磁化，表明存在部分补偿退磁场的垂直各向异性。定量分析得界面各向异性常数K_S=+0.17 erg cm^-2（利于垂直磁化）、体积各向异性常数K_V=-1.23×10^6 erg cm^-3（利于面内），各向异性交叉厚度t_c≈27 Å；FMR线形不对称性随Ni厚度减小而增强，与界面粗糙度增强一致。
AI.conclusion: Si/Ni多层膜中存在界面垂直各向异性与体积面内各向异性的竞争，Ni厚度和界面质量是调控其磁性并推动硅兼容自旋电子学应用的关键因素。

title: Nano-ARPES observation of a flat band at the \bar{M} point in 2.4{\deg} twisted bilayer graphene
summary: The emergence of flat bands in twisted bilayer graphene at the so-called magic angle reveals a range of intriguing phases, such as superconductivity and Mott insulating states, resulting from electrons entering a correlated state. This establishes twisted bilayer graphene as an excellent platform for exploring correlation effects in many-body phases and across various twist angles. However, in most cases, the twist angle is not an easy parameter to control because it exhibits structural instabilities such as relaxation and reconstruction that reduce the correlation effects. Here, we report the unexpected appearance of a flat band at the \bar{M} point far from the Fermi level in a 2.4{\deg} twisted bilayer graphene, directly visualized by angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. Our work is the first observation of flat bands away from the \bar{K} point in twisted bilayer graphene and highlights the need to probe the entire Brillouin zone to fully capture electronic states in twisted structures.

AI.tldr: 在2.4°扭转双层石墨烯中，利用角分辨光电子能谱在远离费米能级的\bar{M}点观察到意外出现的平带，这是首次在\bar{K}点之外发现该类平带。
AI.motivation: 魔角扭转双层石墨烯中的平带可引发超导、莫特绝缘等关联态，是研究多体关联效应的平台；但转角受弛豫和重构等结构不稳定性影响而难以控制，且以往研究多聚焦于\bar{K}点附近，需检验整个布里渊区的电子态。
AI.method: 采用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）直接观测2.4°扭转双层石墨烯的电子能带结构。
AI.result: 在2.4°扭转双层石墨烯中，于远离费米能级的\bar{M}点观察到平带，突破了此前平带主要出现在\bar{K}点附近的认知。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次在扭转双层石墨烯中观察到\bar{K}点之外的平带，表明需探测整个布里渊区才能完整捕捉扭转结构中的电子态，并凸显结构参数与关联效应之间的复杂关系。

title: Spontaneous Decay of High Energy Composite Fermions
summary: An electron, when added to a fractional quantum Hall fluid, famously splits into fractionally charged composite-fermion quasiparticles. We show here that a high energy composite fermion carrying a fractional charge decays into a collection of particles, including quasiparticles, quasiholes, and even whole electrons.

AI.tldr: 分数量子霍尔流体中，注入电子会分数化为带分数电荷的复合费米子准粒子；本文指出高能复合费米子会衰变，产物包括准粒子、准空穴甚至完整电子。
AI.motivation: 理解分数量子霍尔体系中高能复合费米子的命运，以及分数电荷准粒子在高能激发下是否稳定、其衰变通道如何包含整数电荷电子。
AI.method: 摘要未给出具体计算或实验方法，仅报告理论论证的衰变过程：考察携带分数电荷的高能复合费米子向多粒子终态的衰变。
AI.result: 一个高能、带分数电荷的复合费米子会衰变为一组粒子，其中包括准粒子、准空穴以及完整电子。
AI.conclusion: 高能复合费米子并非稳定终态；分数化准粒子可衰变并伴随完整电子等整数电荷激发出现，表明分数量子霍尔激发的高能弛豫和衰变通道比低能准粒子图像更丰富。

title: Floquet Engineering of Momentum Gaps in Magnonic Time Crystals: Slow-Drive Amplification and In-Gap Propagation
summary: Photonic time crystals host momentum gaps in which waves grow exponentially but cannot propagate. We establish their magnonic counterpart in a thin film with periodically switched anisotropy, deriving its Floquet band structure and confirming it micromagnetically. Gaps require a precession-ellipticity contrast. The waveform controls high-order gaps: a single 1~GHz switching drive amplifies a comb of spin-wave bands, from 2.5 to 4.5~GHz, above Gilbert losses even with smoothed edges, unlike sinusoidal modulation. With the Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction, amplified packets propagate inside the gap while growing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了磁性时间晶体：在周期切换各向异性的薄膜中实现自旋波动量带隙与指数放大。
AI.motivation: 将光子时间晶体的动量带隙和波放大概念推广到磁子学，探索可调控的自旋波时间晶体平台。
AI.method: 对周期切换各向异性的薄膜推导Floquet能带结构，并用微磁学模拟验证；分析进动椭圆度对比、切换波形对高阶带隙的影响，以及Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用下的传播行为。
AI.result: 带隙需要进动椭圆度对比；单一1 GHz切换驱动可放大2.5–4.5 GHz的自旋波带梳，即使边缘平滑也能超过Gilbert损耗，而正弦调制不具备该效果；引入Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用后，放大波包可在带隙内边传播边增长。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了磁子时间晶体，实现了波形控制的高阶动量带隙与自旋波放大，并揭示了Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用下带隙内传播放大模式。

title: Magnons and excitons from Bethe-Salpeter equation and its application to graphene-based magnets
summary: With the recent isolation of two-dimensional semiconducting magnetic materials, the theoretical study of spin-flip collective excitations (magnons) along with spin-conserving electron-hole bound pairs (excitons) has become particularly relevant. Describing both types of quasiparticles within the same theoretical framework is possible, in principle, but the well-established many-body formalism for the calculation of excitons, based on the intertwined Bethe-Salpeter and Hedin's equations, is not satisfactory for magnons, since the usual approximations produce a spurious gapped Goldstone mode. Here, we show that excitons and magnons can be computed on the same footing under the same Bethe-Salpeter formalism, while respecting the gapless Goldstone mode for magnons. We demonstrate how this can be achieved through the evaluation of the full Bethe-Salpeter equation, beyond the Tamm-Dancoff approximation in model Hamiltonians. As an example, we apply it to ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic graphene, faithfully represented by the extended Hubbard model. Our results clarify the roles of on-site and non-local interactions in exciton and magnon appearance and identify consistency requirements relevant to extending the approach to first-principles calculations.

AI.tldr: 该文提出在同一Bethe-Salpeter方程框架下统一计算激子与磁振子，并通过在模型哈密顿量中求解超出Tamm-Dancoff近似的完整BSE，避免磁振子Goldstone模出现虚假能隙；以扩展Hubbard模型描述的铁磁和反铁磁石墨烯为例验证。
AI.motivation: 二维半导体磁性材料中磁振子和激子均很重要；现有基于BSE与Hedin方程的多体方法适合激子，但对磁振子因常规近似产生有能隙的虚假Goldstone模而不满意，需要统一且保持Goldstone定理的框架。
AI.method: 在同一BSE形式下处理激子与磁振子；不采用Tamm-Dancoff近似，求解完整BSE；在扩展Hubbard模型中对铁磁和反铁磁石墨烯进行计算。
AI.result: 成功同时描述激子和磁振子并保持磁振子无隙Goldstone模；阐明在位相互作用与非局域相互作用在激子和磁振子出现中的作用；指出将方法推广至第一性原理计算所需的一致性条件。
AI.conclusion: 完整BSE可统一且一致地描述激子与磁振子，为二维磁性半导体等关联磁性材料的多体激发计算及第一性原理扩展提供可行路线。

title: Configuration-Independent Low-Energy Gaps in Graphene Nanoribbons: A $\delta$-Scatterer Transfer-Matrix Approach
summary: Transport measurements on lithographically patterned graphene nanoribbons suggest that the gap depends primarily on ribbon width rather than on crystallographic edge orientation, in contrast to predictions of ideal tight-binding models. To address this, we develop a transfer-matrix approach, based on the theory of finite periodic systems, in which each carbon atom of the honeycomb lattice is represented by an individual $\delta$-scatterer with interaction strength $\gamma^{}_{\delta}$ and the nanoribbon is treated as a confined multichannel finite periodic system. We derive the unit-cell transfer matrix for both arm-chair and zig-zag edge configurations and obtain the transmission and channel-coupling coefficients in closed form. The transmission spectra display the resonant band structure characteristic of finite periodic systems, with the number of resonances per allowed band increasing with the number of unit cells. For $\gamma_{\delta}=0$ the ribbons are fully transparent; for $\gamma_{\delta}>0$ a low-energy transport gap opens and grows linearly with the scatterer strength, $\Delta=0.364265\,\gamma_{\delta}$, identically for arm-chair and zig-zag edges. These results are consistent with the reported absence of a systematic dependence on orientation, while the analytical results show that interchannel coupling vanishes exactly for arm-chair ribbons and decreases with increasing width for zig-zag ribbons, revealing the role of edge geometry. Together, these findings indicate that atomic-scale scattering, represented by the $\delta$-potential formalism, provides a common orientation-independent contribution to the low-energy transport gap in the pristine ribbons considered here.

AI.tldr: 该文用有限周期系统的转移矩阵方法证明：在仅考虑原子尺度δ散射时，石墨烯纳米带的低能输运带隙主要由宽度和散射强度决定，而非边缘取向。
AI.motivation: 实验上图案化石墨烯纳米带的输运测量表明带隙主要依赖宽度而非晶向边缘取向，这与理想紧束缚模型预测不符，因此需要解释边缘取向无关的带隙来源。
AI.method: 作者基于有限周期系统理论建立转移矩阵方法，将蜂窝晶格中每个碳原子表示为相互作用强度为γδ的δ散射体，把纳米带视为受限多通道有限周期系统；推导了扶手椅型和锯齿型边缘的单元胞转移矩阵，并给出透射系数与通道耦合系数的闭式结果。
AI.result: 透射谱呈现有限周期系统特有的共振能带结构，每个允许带内的共振数随单元胞数增加；γδ=0时纳米带完全透明，γδ>0时低能输运带隙打开并随散射强度线性增长，Δ=0.364265γδ，且扶手椅型和锯齿型边缘完全相同。通道间耦合在扶手椅型纳米带中严格为零，在锯齿型纳米带中随宽度增加而减小。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明，δ势形式描述的原子尺度散射为所研究的原始纳米带低能输运带隙提供了共同的、与取向无关的贡献，从而解释了实验中缺乏系统性边缘取向依赖的现象；同时边缘几何主要影响通道耦合。

title: Robustness of Skyrmion-Mediated Magnetization Switching in Perpendicular Magnetic Tunnel Junctions (p-MTJs) to Material Disorder and Elevated Temperature
summary: Transient-skyrmion mediated voltage-controlled magnetic anisotropy (VCMA) switching is a fast and energy efficient way to magnetization reversal, but its reliability under realistic material disorder and thermal fluctuations remain unclear. In this work, we use stochastic micromagnetic simulations of a 100 nm perpendicular magnetic tunnel junction to study switching reliability under grain-scale variations in Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction, perpendicular magnetic anisotropy, easy-axis orientation, and intergrain exchange coupling. We find that switching remains robust under moderate disorder, with 100% switching observed in 10^4 stochastic simulations after pulse width optimization at both 300 K and 350 K. Increasing the temperature from 300 to 350 K shifts the optimum VCMA pulse width from ~475 to ~450 ps, indicating that an apparent reduction in switching probability at a fixed pulse duration can be primarily due to pulse detuning. In contrast, strong easy-axis disorder reduces the maximum switching probability even after pulse-width optimization, indicating degradation of the switching dynamics. We further show that, under strong easy-axis disorder a transient skyrmion still forms while the subsequent post-pulse dynamics fails to complete the magnetization reversal. Our study therefore establishes the distinction between recoverable reliability due to timing shifts and permanent disorder-induced degradation that simply cannot be recovered by pulse re-tuning. Finally, for no disorders but at room temperature, 100% switching is observed with 10^6 stochastic simulations with correct pulse shaping.

AI.tldr: 该文通过随机微磁模拟研究瞬态斯格明子介导的VCMA磁化翻转在材料无序与热涨落下的可靠性，区分可由脉冲重调恢复的时序失谐与不可恢复的强易轴无序退化。
AI.motivation: 瞬态斯格明子介导的VCMA翻转快速且节能，但其在真实材料无序和热涨落下的可靠性尚不明确。
AI.method: 对100 nm垂直磁隧道结进行随机微磁模拟，引入晶粒尺度的Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用、垂直磁各向异性、易轴取向和晶粒间交换耦合变化，并在300 K与350 K下统计翻转概率。
AI.result: 中等无序下翻转稳健：脉冲宽度优化后，300 K和350 K下10^4次随机模拟均实现100%翻转；温度由300升至350 K使最佳VCMA脉冲宽度由约475 ps移至约450 ps，固定脉宽下概率下降主要源于脉冲失谐。强易轴无序即使优化脉宽也降低最大翻转概率；此时瞬态斯格明子仍形成，但脉冲后动力学无法完成磁化反转。无无序室温下，正确脉冲整形时10^6次模拟实现100%翻转。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了可恢复的时序失谐可靠性与不可通过脉冲重调恢复的永久性无序退化之间的区别，强调强易轴无序会从根本上劣化瞬态斯格明子介导的VCMA翻转动力学。

title: Phonon evidence for a partial, re-entrant spin reorientation near room temperature in LaFe$_{1-x}$Ni$_x$O$_3$
summary: Spin reorientation near room temperature offers a route to controlling antiferromagnetic order, yet LaFeO$3$, which lacks a magnetic rare-earth ion, is generally expected to retain its spin orientation along the $a$ axis below $T{\mathrm N}\approx740$~K. Here, we investigate LaFe$_{1-x}$Ni$_x$O$_3$ ($x=0$ and 0.1) using temperature-dependent magnetization and Raman spectroscopy over 200--400~K. Both compositions exhibit magnetic anomalies at 285.6 and 323~K, respectively, accompanied by correlated deviations of 12 Raman modes from their conventional anharmonic behavior. Principal component analysis and a global fitting approach reveal a common temperature-dependent phonon response, with mode-dependent amplitudes and signs. To interpret these anomalies, we develop a Landau-based spin-phonon coupling model describing complete, partial re-entrant, and incipient spin reorientation. Comparison with the experimental Raman profiles favors a partial, re-entrant rotation of the N'eel vector in both compositions, centered near 290~K. Ni substitution narrows the characteristic reorientation interval from approximately 116 to 84~K and enhances the magnetization anomaly by a factor of four. An additional feature near 262~K in LaFeO$_3$ is consistent with the Morin transition of trace $\alpha$-Fe$_2$O$_3$. These findings suggest that partial spin reorientation can emerge without magnetic rare-earth ions and establish collective Raman phonon anomalies as a sensitive indirect probe of magnetic anisotropy changes in orthoferrites.

AI.tldr: 该文在无磁性稀土离子的LaFeO3及LaFe0.9Ni0.1O3中，通过磁化和拉曼谱发现近室温的部分、再入式Néel矢量转动，并证明集体拉曼声子异常可作为磁各向异性变化的灵敏间接探针。
AI.motivation: 近室温自旋重取向可用于调控反铁磁序，但LaFeO3缺乏磁性稀土离子，通常被认为在T_N≈740 K以下仍保持自旋沿a轴取向；作者旨在检验其是否仍能出现自旋重取向，并寻找间接探测手段。
AI.method: 制备LaFe1-xNixO3（x=0和0.1），在200–400 K进行变温磁化与拉曼光谱测量；用主成分分析和全局拟合提取声子响应，并建立基于Landau理论的spin-phonon耦合模型，区分完全、部分再入式和初始型自旋重取向。
AI.result: 两种组分分别在285.6 K和323 K出现磁异常，并有12个拉曼模偏离常规非谐行为；拟合支持两者均在约290 K附近发生部分、再入式Néel矢量转动。Ni替代将特征重取向区间由约116 K缩窄至84 K，并使磁化异常增强约4倍；LaFeO3中262 K附近附加特征可归因于痕量α-Fe2O3的Morin转变。
AI.conclusion: 部分自旋重取向可在不含磁性稀土离子的正交铁氧体中发生；与自旋重取向相关的集体拉曼声子异常是探测orthoferrites磁各向异性变化的敏感间接探针。

title: Strontium Titanate Capping Layers as Kinetic Regulators of Redox Phase Transitions in Oxide Heterostructures
summary: Oxide capping layers are widely used to protect and stabilize thin-film heterostructures, yet their role in governing phase-transition kinetics remains largely unexplored. Here, we uncover the kinetic function of few-nanometer-thick SrTiO$_3$ (STO) capping layers in controlling oxidation and reduction processes, using real-time in situ optical spectroscopic ellipsometry. We show that oxygen diffusion through the nanoscale capping layer constitutes the rate-limiting step, giving rise to diffusion-controlled phase transitions in the underlying materials. As a result, both capping-layer thickness and oxygen partial pressure provide effective handles to tune phase transition temperatures. Quantitative analysis yields an activation energy of $E_A$ = 0.64 $\pm$0.06 eV for oxygen diffusion through STO, highlighting its suitability for precise control of redox reactions in diverse material systems. These results establish oxide capping layers as active kinetic regulators of redox-driven phase transitions and offer a general framework for engineering redox dynamics in complex oxide heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现几纳米厚SrTiO₃覆盖层并非惰性保护层，而是通过限制氧扩散主动调控底层材料的氧化还原相变动力学。
AI.motivation: 氧化物覆盖层广泛用于保护薄膜异质结构，但其对相变动力学的调控作用尚不清楚。
AI.method: 利用实时原位光学光谱椭偏仪，研究STO覆盖层厚度和氧分压对氧化/还原过程及相变温度的影响，并进行定量动力学分析。
AI.result: 氧穿过纳米级覆盖层的扩散是限速步骤，使相变呈扩散控制；覆盖层厚度和氧分压可调节相变温度；STO中氧扩散活化能为0.64±0.06 eV。
AI.conclusion: 氧化物覆盖层可作为氧化还原驱动相变的主动动力学调节器，为复杂氧化物异质结构中的氧化还原动力学工程提供通用框架。

title: Intrinsic Paramagnetism of Optical Phonons and Thermal Hall Effect in Quantum Paraelectrics
summary: We propose a microscopic theory of the phonon-mediated thermal Hall effect in quantum paraelectrics, driven by the intrinsic paramagnetism due to quantum fluctuations of the (nearly) critical optical phonon modes. The effective magnetization due to temporal fluctuations of the assosciated dipoles couple to an external magnetic field resulting the magnetoelectric term $\mathbf{H} \cdot (\mathbf{P} \times \dot{\mathbf{P}})$ in the effective Lagrangian density of the polarisation field $\mathbf{P}$. This coupling splits the transverse optical phonon spectrum into right- and left-circularly polarized chiral branches. Using the chiral phonon Green's functions and the Kubo formalism, we derive the thermal Hall conductivity $\kappa_{xy}$ from the heat-current correlation function. We observe that $\kappa_{xy}$ is proportional to the difference in spectral weights of the two chiral modes, $\kappa_{xy} \propto A_+^2 - A_-^2$, establishing a direct microscopic link between phonon chirality and transverse heat transport. Our theory predicts three key observations: (i) a linear-in-magnetic-field response $\kappa_{xy} \propto H$ at low fields, evolving into nonlinear behavior at higher fields (ii) a non-monotonic temperature dependence of $\kappa_{xy}$ with a peak arising from the competition between thermal population and phonon scattering and (iii) strong enhancement of $\kappa_{xy}$ near the quantum critical point $\omega_0 \to 0$, it exhibits power-law scaling $\kappa_{xy} \propto T^{\alpha}$ with $\alpha \approx 0.41$. Our findings provide an understanding of thermal Hall transport in quantum paraelectrics due to intrinsic paramagnetism and is aligned with the observed behaviour in SrTiO$_3$ and related materials.

AI.tldr: 该文提出量子顺电体中由近临界光学声子量子涨落的本征顺磁性驱动的声子介导热霍尔效应微观理论，并用手性声子格林函数与Kubo公式推导热霍尔电导率。
AI.motivation: 解释量子顺电体（如SrTiO3及相关材料）中观测到的热霍尔输运，特别是声子手性与横向热输运之间的微观联系。
AI.method: 通过极化场有效拉格朗日量中的磁电项 H·(P×Ṗ) 描述偶极矩时间涨落诱导的有效磁化与外磁场耦合；该耦合使横向光学声子分裂为右旋和左旋圆偏振手性支。利用手性声子格林函数和Kubo形式，从热流关联函数推导热霍尔电导率 κxy。
AI.result: 理论给出 κxy ∝ A_+^2 - A_-^2，即正比于两个手性模式谱重之差；预测低场下 κxy ∝ H 的线性响应并在高场转为非线性，温度依赖非单调且因热布居与声子散射竞争出现峰值，并在量子临界点 ω0→0 附近显著增强，呈 κxy ∝ T^α、α≈0.41 的幂律标度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了量子顺电体中本征顺磁性、声子手性与热霍尔输运的直接微观联系，并与SrTiO3及相关材料中的观测行为一致。

title: Interface Control of Second-Harmonic Generation in Layered CuInP2S6 via PbZr0.2Ti0.8O3 Domain Wall
summary: The control of nonlinear optical responses in van der Waals ferroelectrics at the nanoscale offers opportunities for developing two-dimensional integrated nanophotonics with programmable functionalities. In this work, we report the first realization of nanoscale nonvolatile control of the amplitude and polarization of second-harmonic generation (SHG) response in layered CuInP2S6 (CIPS) via the domain structure in an interfacial PbZr0.2Ti0.8O3 (PZT) thin film. The SHG intensity at CIPS/PZT heterointerface is continuously modulated, either substantially enhanced or almost entirely quenched, by the circular domain walls in underlying ferroelectric oxide. The interfacial coupling of CIPS polar axis with in-plane polarization of PZT domain walls tailors the SHG light polarization into two-fold (C2V) symmetry, which is well modeled by nonlinear electromagnetic theory. Overall, this study enables nonvolatile programmable design of nonlinear light intensity and polarization in van der Waals ferroelectrics at the nanoscale.

AI.tldr: 利用PZT铁电畴结构在纳米尺度非易失地调控CIPS范德华铁电体的二次谐波产生（SHG）强度与偏振。
AI.motivation: 二维集成纳米光子学需要可编程的非线性光学响应，而范德华铁电体中纳米尺度、非易失的SHG调控仍待实现。
AI.method: 构建CIPS/PZT异质界面，通过PZT圆形畴壁及其面内极化与CIPS极性轴耦合调控SHG，并结合非线性电磁理论建模。
AI.result: SHG强度可被连续调制，既可显著增强也可几乎完全淬灭；SHG偏振被裁剪为二重（C2v）对称，并与理论模型吻合。
AI.conclusion: 实现了纳米尺度非易失可编程的非线性光强与偏振设计，为二维集成纳米光子学提供可行途径。

title: Finite-Temperature Transconductance of Multiterminal Josephson Junctions with Topological Andreev Spectra
summary: Multiterminal Josephson junctions (MTJJs) provide a controllable platform for engineering topological Andreev spectra. At zero temperature, Andreev bound states (ABSs) with nonzero Chern numbers give rise to quantized transconductance between superconducting terminals. We derive the finite-temperature transconductance of MTJJs using linear-response theory. We first demonstrate the destructive role of temperature: changes in the thermal occupations of the ABSs destroy exact transconductance quantization. We then show that finite temperature can also play a constructive role by making the transconductance sensitive to finite-energy topological crossings hidden from the zero-temperature response. Our results establish the thermal limitations of transconductance quantization and identify finite-temperature transport as a probe of otherwise inaccessible topology in Andreev spectra.

AI.tldr: 本文用线性响应理论推导多端约瑟夫森结（MTJJ）的有限温度跨导，指出温度既会破坏零温下由非零陈数安德烈夫束缚态导致的跨导量子化，也能使有限能拓扑交叉变得可探测。
AI.motivation: MTJJ可调控安德烈夫谱并实现拓扑，零温下非零陈数的安德烈夫束缚态（ABS）会产生超导端间的量子化跨导；需要理解有限温度对跨导量子化及拓扑探测的影响。
AI.method: 基于线性响应理论推导MTJJ在有限温度下的跨导。
AI.result: 温度通过改变ABS的热占据破坏跨导的精确量子化；同时，有限温度可使跨导对零温响应中隐藏的有限能拓扑交叉敏感。
AI.conclusion: 研究明确了跨导量子化的热限制，并表明有限温度输运可作为探测安德烈夫谱中原本不可及拓扑的工具。

title: Nonadiabatic vibrational dynamics of CO on Pt(111) studied with first-principles many-body perturbation theory
summary: We investigate the nonequilibrium vibrational dynamics of CO adsorbed on Pt(111), a prototypical adsorbate-surface system for ultrafast vibrational spectroscopy, using a first-principles framework that combines many-body perturbation theory with density functional theory. Within this methodology we explicitly account for electron-hole pair excitations and electron-mediated phonon-phonon coupling. For the latter mechanism, we evaluate the vertex-correction screening, what constitutes a methodological novelty. Our calculations qualitatively reproduce the transient evolution of the internal stretch vibrational mode observed in femtosecond pump-probe experiments, allowing us to identify in the experimental measurements a small transient blueshift after excitation with a femtosecond laser pulse. As predicted in a previous work, the reduction in the number of electronic states available for electron-phonon coupling when the electronic temperature raises at a group 10 transition metal surface, effectively screens the electron-phonon interaction giving rise to an anomalous transient blue-shift.

AI.tldr: 本文用第一性原理研究CO/Pt(111)的非平衡振动动力学，重现飞秒泵浦-探测实验中内伸缩振动模的瞬态演化，并指认激发后的小幅瞬态蓝移。
AI.motivation: CO吸附于Pt(111)是超快振动光谱的典型吸附物-表面体系，需厘清电子-空穴对激发与电子介导声子-声子耦合等非平衡耗散机制对振动动力学的影响。
AI.method: 结合多体微扰理论与密度泛函理论的第一性原理框架，显式处理电子-空穴对激发和电子介导的声子-声子耦合；对后者评估顶点修正屏蔽，作为方法学新进展。
AI.result: 计算定性重现了飞秒泵浦-探测实验中内伸缩振动模的瞬态演化，并在实验测量中识别出激发后的小幅瞬态蓝移。
AI.conclusion: 当电子温度升高时，第10族过渡金属表面可用于电子-声子耦合的电子态数目减少，有效屏蔽电子-声子相互作用，从而产生异常的瞬态蓝移，与先前理论预测一致。

title: Altermagnetism in Folded Iron Chain Systems
summary: Altermagnetism, a moment-compensated magnetism with momentum-dependent spin splitting, has so far been realized primarily in N\'{e}el-type antiferromagnets. Here, we demonstrate altermagnetism in folded iron-chain systems with block-type magnetic order (e.g., $\uparrow \uparrow \downarrow \downarrow$). In the strictly one-dimensional (1D) case, altermagnetism is forbidden by the $[C_2||{\cal T}]$ symmetry, but it can emerge when such chains are stacked into a quasi-1D array. To generate altermagnetic spin splitting via this chain-stacking mechanism, two essential ingredients are required: a block-type spin order that spontaneously breaks the combined parity-time reversal symmetry, and finite inter-chain hopping. Using first-principles calculations, we identify the K$_3$Fe$_2$Se$_4$ family as a promising platform that realizes this mechanism, hosting a $d$-wave altermagnet even without lattice $C_{4}$ symmetry. Moreover, owing to its lower symmetry, the block-type folded chain exhibits an isotropic altermagnetic spin splitting, which may manifest as an altermagnetic wrapping effect. Our findings unify real-space block magnetism and reciprocal-space altermagnetism, establishing folded iron chains as a tunable platform for zero-moment spintronic applications.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并在折叠铁链的块型磁序（如↑↑↓↓）中实现交错磁（altermagnetism），指出严格一维受[C2||T]对称性禁止，但准一维链堆叠可产生动量依赖自旋劈裂，并在K3Fe2Se4家族中通过第一性原理计算验证。
AI.motivation: 交错磁此前主要在Néel型反铁磁体中实现；作者希望拓展到具有块型磁序的折叠铁链体系，并统一实空间块磁性与倒空间交错磁性。
AI.method: 通过对称性分析表明严格1D中交错磁被[C2||T]禁止，而准1D链堆叠需要块型自旋序自发破缺联合宇称-时间反演对称性以及有限链间跃迁；采用第一性原理计算筛选并验证K3Fe2Se4家族。
AI.result: K3Fe2Se4家族可实现该链堆叠机制，即使没有晶格C4对称性也表现为d波交错磁体；由于对称性较低，块型折叠链呈现各向同性交错磁自旋劈裂，并可能表现为交错磁包裹效应。
AI.conclusion: 研究将实空间块磁性与倒空间交错磁性联系起来，确立折叠铁链为可调零磁矩自旋电子学平台。

title: Thermoelectric properties and modulation doping of ultrawide-bandgap nitride monolayers
summary: Two-dimensional III-nitride alloys provide a composition-tunable platform for exploring thermoelectric transport and intrinsic electric-field tolerance. We combine first-principles electronic-structure calculations with semiclassical transport for ordered monolayer B$_{x}$Al$_{1-x}$N and B$_{x}$Ga$_{1-x}$N. State-dependent momentum relaxation times computed with AMSET include acoustic deformation-potential and piezoelectric scattering. Using a common, temperature-independent lattice thermal conductivity of 550 W/mK, we predict maximum thermoelectric figure of merit ZT>2.5 for selected p- and n-type monolayers and ZT>2 at 300~K for n-type B$_{0.25}$Ga$_{0.75}$N. Composition-dependent band curvature, screening, and scattering help interpret the different p- and n-type responses. Vacuum-referenced band alignments identify candidate modulation-doping partners for both carrier types; explicit hGaN/V$_2$O$_5$ calculations yield a hole surface density of approximately 1.6$\times10^{14}$ cm$^{-2}$. A separate phenomenological model using the band gap and maximum phonon frequency predicts intrinsic breakdown fields of 20.06 and 20.74 MVcm for the Al- and Ga-containing x=0.75 alloys, respectively. These results motivate further investigation for thermoelectric and high-field power-electronic applications. The ZT values apply to the specified scattering and lattice-conductivity models, while the breakdown estimates require validation for monolayers and do not resolve field direction.

AI.tldr: 结合第一性原理电子结构计算与半经典输运，研究有序单层BxAl1-xN和BxGa1-xN的热电性能与本征击穿场，预测选定p型和n型单层ZT>2.5、300 K下n型B0.25Ga0.75N的ZT>2，并给出调制掺杂候选及约20 MV/cm量级击穿场估计。
AI.motivation: 二维III族氮化物合金具有成分可调平台，可用于探索热电输运和本征电场耐受性，因此需要评估其热电优值、掺杂策略和高场应用潜力。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理电子结构计算结合半经典输运；用AMSET计算态依赖动量弛豫时间，包含声学形变势散射和压电散射；使用温度无关晶格热导率550 W/mK；通过真空参考能带对齐筛选调制掺杂伙伴；用基于带隙和最大声子频率的唯象模型预测本征击穿场；并显式计算hGaN/V2O5界面的空穴面密度。
AI.result: 选定p型和n型单层预测最大ZT>2.5；n型B0.25Ga0.75N在300 K时ZT>2；hGaN/V2O5计算得到空穴面密度约1.6×10^14 cm^-2；x=0.75的含Al和含Ga合金本征击穿场分别约为20.06和20.74 MV/cm；成分依赖的带曲率、屏蔽和散射用于解释p型和n型响应差异。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果支持进一步研究该类二维III族氮化物在热电器件和高场功率电子器件中的应用；但ZT值依赖所设定的散射和晶格热导率模型，击穿场估计仍需针对单层验证，且未区分电场方向。

title: Unifying Low-Frequency Raman and Infrared Signatures across Perovskites
summary: Perovskites have been studied for a wide range of applications, from oxide-based ferroelectrics to halide-perovskite photovoltaics. Despite their diverse functionalities, these materials share strong lattice anharmonicity arising from structural instabilities such as polar off-centering and octahedral tilting. These anharmonic distortions strongly influence the low-frequency vibrational response and can be observed in infrared (IR) and Raman spectra. However, low-frequency IR and Raman signatures are typically investigated separately, hindering the development of a unified understanding of vibrational spectroscopy across perovskite classes. In this work, we use machine-learning-based molecular dynamics to simulate the IR and Raman spectra of oxide perovskites (SrTiO$_3$ and BaTiO$_3$), halide perovskites (CsPbBr$_3$, CsSnBr$_3$, and CsGeBr$_3$) and double halide perovskites (Cs$_2$AgAlBr$_6$ and Cs$_2$AgBiBr$_6$). By comparing materials exhibiting polar, tilt-driven and mixed instabilities, we find that polar off-centering leads to enhanced low-frequency IR and dielectric responses, whereas nonpolar modes, particularly octahedral tilting, are associated with Raman central peaks. The strength of the low-frequency features also depends on how strongly the underlying modes couple to polarization or dielectric susceptibility. Finally, we show that the dynamics of these instabilities play an important role, with slow polar reorientations shifting the dielectric response to very low frequencies and overdamped tilting modes producing persistent Raman central peaks. These results establish a unified framework connecting low-frequency IR and Raman spectra to the symmetry, coupling and dynamics of their underlying anharmonic lattice instabilities.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用机器学习分子动力学统一模拟并比较多类钙钛矿的低频红外与拉曼光谱，揭示其与极性偏心、八面体倾转等非谐晶格不稳定性之间的关系。
AI.motivation: 钙钛矿普遍存在由极性偏心、八面体倾转等结构不稳定性引起的强晶格非谐性，显著影响低频振动响应；但低频红外与拉曼特征通常被分开研究，缺乏跨钙钛矿体系的统一振动光谱理解。
AI.method: 采用基于机器学习的分子动力学模拟氧化物钙钛矿（SrTiO3、BaTiO3）、卤化物钙钛矿（CsPbBr3、CsSnBr3、CsGeBr3）及双卤化物钙钛矿（Cs2AgAlBr6、Cs2AgBiBr6）的红外和拉曼光谱，并比较极性、倾转驱动及混合不稳定性体系。
AI.result: 发现极性偏心增强低频红外与介电响应，而非极性模式尤其是八面体倾转对应拉曼中心峰；低频特征强度取决于模式与极化或介电 susceptibility 的耦合强弱；动力学亦关键，慢极性重取向将介电响应移至极低频，过阻尼倾转模式产生持续拉曼中心峰。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了统一框架，将低频红外与拉曼光谱同其背后非谐晶格不稳定性的对称性、耦合及动力学联系起来。

title: Sub-monolayer tracking of molecular states at buried interfaces
summary: Phenomena responsible for emerging technologies originate from novel molecular states at buried interfaces. Yet quantitatively resolving these features is out of reach in most cases. Resonant scattering has demonstrated sensitivity to these local states but is limited due to a lack of accurate interpretive models. We leverage a machine learning (ML)-optimized optical model to analyze polarized resonant soft X-ray scattering (RSoXS) from molecular thin films. This new analysis establishes the direct and quantitative interpretation of molecular orientation, chemical identity and packing states as a function of depth with sub-monolayer resolution - reaching beyond the diffraction limit via locking energy and polarization through the optical model. From our analysis, we discover a gradient evolution of molecular orientation and packing emerging from the interface, indicative of competing surface versus bulk growth dynamics and contradicting hypotheses of substrate patterning. This nondestructive insight into buried interfacial formation and final state opens possibilities in controlling interfacial states and phenomena in next-generation technologies.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用机器学习优化的光学模型解析分子薄膜的偏振共振软X射线散射，实现埋藏界面处分子取向、化学身份和堆积状态的定量深度分辨。
AI.motivation: 新兴技术中的现象常源于埋藏界面的新型分子态，但现有手段难以定量解析；共振散射虽敏感，却缺乏准确解释模型。
AI.method: 构建机器学习优化的光学模型，通过锁定能量和偏振分析偏振共振软X射线散射（RSoXS），突破衍射极限并获得亚单层深度分辨率。
AI.result: 实现了对分子取向、化学身份和堆积状态随深度变化的直接定量解析，并发现从界面处出现的分子取向与堆积梯度演化。
AI.conclusion: 该无损分析揭示了埋藏界面的形成与终态，表明表面与体相生长动力学竞争，并反驳基底图案化假设，为调控界面态和下一代技术现象提供可能。

title: Poly(vinylidene fluoride) under finite electric displacement fields: a removable $\alpha\!\to\!\delta$ reorientation barrier and a persistent first-order $\delta\!\to\!\beta$ conformational change
summary: The $\alpha$, $\delta$, and $\beta$ phases of PVDF are interconverted by electrical poling and mechanical drawing, yet the thermodynamics under a controlled electrical boundary condition has not been established from first principles. We evaluate the zero-temperature free energy at fixed electric displacement $D$ from van der Waals density-functional calculations along two constrained coordinates in a common 24-atom cell: a tilt of the gauche C--C bonds that maps antipolar $\alpha$ onto polar $\delta$ (cell change $<1\%$), and a backbone torsion that straightens TG$^+$TG$^-$ chains into all-trans $\beta$ (chain-repeat strain $10.6\%$). As $D$ increases from 0 to $0.30$~C\,m$^{-2}$, the lowest homogeneous free energy switches from $\alpha$ to $\delta$ at $D_{c1}=0.046$~C\,m$^{-2}$ and from $\delta$ to $\beta$ at $D_{c2}=0.157$~C\,m$^{-2}$. At $T=0$ with domain-wall energy neglected, a $\delta$ multidomain state lies $14.3$~meV per cell below homogeneous $\alpha$ at every $D$. A $\Gamma$-point harmonic estimate suggests that vibrations reverse this ordering at room temperature. $\delta$ and $\beta$ coexist for $0.11<D<0.21$~C\,m$^{-2}$ at $E^*=0.69$~GV\,m$^{-1}$, independent of the screening constant. The tilt barrier falls from $0.66$~eV per cell at $D=0$ to $17$~meV at $D=0.30$~C\,m$^{-2}$ (below $k_BT$ at $300$~K), while the torsion barrier remains $0.66$~eV at $D_{c2}$ and $0.34$~eV at $D=0.30$~C\,m$^{-2}$, so $\delta\to\beta$ stays first order. Much of the difference traces to the path effective charge ($0.28e$ for the tilt, $0.18e$ for the torsion). Scaling shows the tilt barrier would survive with the torsion charge; the smaller torsion charge accounts for about half the barrier it retains. The landscape accounts for why a field produces $\delta$ and why $\beta$ is reached by drawing, and suggests that raising that charge could let a field alone produce $\beta$.

AI.tldr: 该文用第一性原理在固定电位移D条件下构建PVDF的α、δ、β相自由能景观，解释了电场易生成δ相而β相通常需机械拉伸，并指出提高路径有效电荷可能使电场直接生成β相。
AI.motivation: PVDF的α、δ、β相可通过电极化和机械拉伸相互转化，但在受控电边界条件下的热力学尚未从第一性原理建立，尤其缺乏对电场与力学路径竞争关系的定量理解。
AI.method: 采用van der Waals密度泛函计算，在共同24原子胞中沿两个约束坐标评估固定电位移D下的零温自由能：gauche C–C键倾转使反极性α转为极性δ（胞变化<1%），以及主链扭转使TG+TG-链伸直为全反式β（链重复应变10.6%）；同时计算转变场、共存区、势垒、多畴态和路径有效电荷。
AI.result: D从0增至0.30 C m−2时，最低均匀自由能依次由α转为δ（Dc1=0.046 C m−2）再转为β（Dc2=0.157 C m−2）。零温忽略畴壁能时，δ多畴态在每个D下均比均匀α低14.3 meV/cell；Γ点谐波估计表明振动可在室温反转该排序。δ与β在0.11<D<0.21 C m−2、E*=0.69 GV m−1下共存且与屏蔽常数无关。倾转势垒从D=0时的0.66 eV/cell降至D=0.30时的17 meV（低于300 K的kBT），而扭转势垒在Dc2仍为0.66 eV、在D=0.30时为0.34 eV，故δ→β保持一级。差异主要源于路径有效电荷：倾转为0.28e，扭转为0.18e；标度分析表明较小扭转电荷解释了其保留势垒约一半。
AI.conclusion: 该自由能景观统一解释了电场极化倾向产生δ相、而β相需机械拉伸达到的原因，并表明若提高扭转路径有效电荷，电场单独作用也可能生成β相。

title: Structural characterization of the rutile-GeO2/TiO2 (001) heterointerface
summary: Rutile-GeO2 (r-GeO2) has emerged as a promising ultrawide-bandgap (UWBG) semiconductor for future high-power device applications because of its favorable combination of physical and electrical properties. This study has used high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HR-TEM) to compare heterointerfaces between thin films of GeO2 grown by metal-organic chemical vapor deposition on closely-lattice-matched rutile TiO2 (r-TiO2) substrates at temperatures of 840{\deg} C and 925{\deg} C. Cross-sectional TEM observations reveal interfaces with two entirely different structures: an amorphous GeOx/r-TiO2 heterostructure with an abrupt, highly faceted and non-planar interface, or a fully epitaxial r-GeO2/r-TiO2 heterostructure characterized by a more wavy but often facetted interface. Structural analysis of the latter sample revealed a high density of strain-relieving interfacial dislocations, identified primarily as Lomer-type or 60{\deg}-type, that accommodated the ~4% lattice mismatch between the two materials, while chemical analysis showed very limited interfacial intermixing. Crystallographic analysis showed that the interface faceting was associated with rutile {101} facets, with characteristic facet angles of ~114{\deg}; these observations support thermally driven TiO2 (001) substrate faceting rather than an interface reconstruction resulting from GeO2 epitaxy. Overall, these findings provide useful insights into the mechanisms governing interface formation and strain relaxation in r-GeO2/r-TiO2 heterostructures and suggest that further refinement of growth conditions should enable improved epitaxial growth of r-GeO2 for future ultrawide-bandgap electronic device applications.

AI.tldr: 利用HR-TEM比较了840°C和925°C下MOCVD生长GeO2/r-TiO2异质界面，发现非晶GeOx/r-TiO2与全外延r-GeO2/r-TiO2两类界面，并揭示约4%失配由Lomer型或60°型位错弛豫，界面刻面主要源于TiO2(001)衬底热致刻面。
AI.motivation: r-GeO2因综合物理与电学性质优异，是有前景的超宽禁带半导体，适用于高功率器件；需理解其异质外延中的界面形成与应变弛豫机制。
AI.method: 在晶格接近匹配的r-TiO2衬底上于840°C和925°C用MOCVD生长GeO2薄膜，采用截面HR-TEM观察界面，并结合结构、化学与晶体学分析。
AI.result: 观察到两种截然不同的界面：一是具有突变、高度刻面且非平面界面的非晶GeOx/r-TiO2异质结构；二是界面呈波浪状但常具刻面的全外延r-GeO2/r-TiO2异质结构。外延样品中高密度界面位错主要为Lomer型或60°型，用于容纳约4%晶格失配，界面互混有限。刻面与金红石{101}面相关，特征角约114°，支持TiO2(001)衬底热致刻面而非GeO2外延导致的界面重构。
AI.conclusion: 研究为r-GeO2/r-TiO2异质结构中的界面形成和应变弛豫机制提供了见解，并表明优化生长条件有望改善r-GeO2外延生长，面向超宽禁带电子器件应用。

title: Nanoscale origin of thermal anisotropy in monoclinic \texorpdfstring{$\beta$-Ga$_2$O$_3$}{beta-Ga2O3}
summary: Monoclinic $\beta$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ is a promising ultra-wide-bandgap semiconductor for power electronics, but its low and anisotropic thermal conductivity limits heat removal, making it a compelling model system for nanoscale thermal transport studies. Here, we demonstrate a pronounced nanoscale enhancement of thermal anisotropy and uncover the underlying phonon mechanism by combining complementary thermal and acoustic spectroscopy techniques with first-principles calculations. Anisotropic thermoreflectance thermometry determines the full thermal-conductivity tensor from angular measurements within the (100), (010), and (001) crystallographic planes. Angle-resolved Brillouin light scattering reveals that low-frequency acoustic phonons exhibit only weak velocity anisotropy, insufficient to account for the measured thermal anisotropy. Frequency-resolved ab initio Green--Kubo calculations show that the bulk anisotropy pattern emerges only when the accumulated conductivity includes phonon modes above 4 THz, whereas the sub 3 THz acoustic contributions are nearly isotropic. Extreme-ultraviolet transient thermal grating spectroscopy reveals that reducing the grating period to 28 nm strongly enhances the in-plane thermal anisotropy, most markedly in the (001) plane, where it reaches nearly twice its macroscopic value. Reconstructed and calculated mean-free-path (MFP) accumulation functions link this enhancement to the stronger directional contrast of short-MFP phonons. Together, these results identify high-frequency, short-MFP phonons as the dominant origin of thermal anisotropy in $\beta$-Ga$_2$O$_3$, while low-frequency phonons attenuate the directional contrast at macroscopic scales.

AI.tldr: 该工作结合热与声学光谱及第一性原理计算，揭示β-Ga2O3中纳米尺度热各向异性增强的声子机制，指出高频、短平均自由程声子是热各向异性的主要来源。
AI.motivation: β-Ga2O3具有超宽禁带但热导率低且各向异性强，限制功率器件散热；其纳米尺度热输运机制尚需厘清，是研究纳米热输运的理想模型体系。
AI.method: 采用角分辨热反射热测量获取(100)、(010)、(001)晶面内热导率全张量；结合角分辨布里渊光散射、频率分辨第一性原理Green-Kubo计算、极紫外瞬态热光栅光谱及平均自由程累积函数分析。
AI.result: 低频声学声子速度各向异性弱，不足以解释测得热各向异性；体态各向异性需累积4 THz以上声子模式才显现，3 THz以下声学贡献近各向同性；光栅周期降至28 nm时面内热各向异性显著增强，尤其在(001)面接近宏观值两倍，源于短平均自由程声子更强的方向对比。
AI.conclusion: β-Ga2O3的热各向异性主要由高频、短平均自由程声子决定，低频声子在宏观尺度上削弱方向对比；纳米尺度下短平均自由程声子贡献增强导致热各向异性显著提升。

title: Intrinsic Raman Modes and Crystal Symmetry of Altermagnetic ${\alpha}$-MnTe
summary: Crystal symmetry governs the physical properties of materials and provides the framework for interpreting their microscopic excitations and macroscopic responses. In altermagnets, the crystal symmetries that relate opposite-spin sublattices give rise to momentum-dependent spin splitting despite compensated magnetization. Determining the real crystal symmetry is therefore essential for understanding the intrinsic electronic and magnetic properties. For the altermagnetic semiconductor ${\alpha}$-MnTe, conflicting Raman assignments have left both its intrinsic lattice excitations and its crystal symmetry unresolved. Here we combine high-resolution Raman and second-harmonic generation (SHG) spectroscopy with first-principles calculations to distinguish intrinsic lattice excitations from Te-derived spectral contributions and to examine bulk inversion symmetry of ${\alpha}$-MnTe. We show that several prominent Raman features previously assigned to ${\alpha}$-MnTe instead originate from segregated Te clusters or precipitates. The remaining intrinsic Raman response consists of a single Raman-active mode assigned to the calculated $E_{2g}$ phonon, consistent with the centrosymmetric $D_{6h}$ symmetry. The SHG response agrees with surface electric-dipole and bulk electric-quadrupole contributions expected for a centrosymmetric $D_{6h}$ crystal, supporting the preservation of bulk inversion symmetry in ${\alpha}$-MnTe. Our findings revise the Raman assignments in ${\alpha}$-MnTe and provide a basis for interpreting its altermagnetic properties within the appropriate crystal-symmetry framework.

AI.tldr: 该工作澄清了α-MnTe长期存在争议的拉曼指认与晶体对称性：多数显著拉曼特征来自析出的Te团簇，本征拉曼响应仅有一个E2g模，支持中心对称的D6h结构，SHG结果亦与D6h中心对称晶体一致。
AI.motivation: α-MnTe作为交错磁半导体，其真实晶体对称性决定自旋劈裂和本征电子/磁性质；但此前拉曼指认相互矛盾，导致其本征晶格激发和晶体对称性未定。
AI.method: 结合高分辨拉曼光谱、二次谐波产生（SHG）光谱与第一性原理计算，区分本征晶格激发与Te相关谱贡献，并检验α-MnTe的体反演对称性。
AI.result: 若干先前归属于α-MnTe的显著拉曼特征实际源于偏析的Te团簇或沉淀；剩余本征拉曼响应仅包含一个拉曼活性模，指认为计算得到的E2g声子，与中心对称D6h对称性相符；SHG响应符合中心对称D6h晶体预期的表面电偶极和体电四极贡献，支持α-MnTe保持体反演对称性。
AI.conclusion: 研究修正了α-MnTe的拉曼指认，并为其在正确晶体对称性框架下解释交错磁性质提供了基础。

title: Flexo-Photoresponses from First Principles
summary: Many functionally important materials, such as silicon, possess high-symmetry crystal structures that forbid even-order nonlinear optical responses, thereby limiting their application in e.g., photonics and optoelectronics. Strain gradients can effectively break symmetries, activating otherwise forbidden optical responses. Although such flexo-photoresponses have attracted considerable interest recently, a comprehensive microscopic theoretical framework is still lacking. Here, we develop a first-principles approach that can systematically evaluate a wide range of flexo-photoresponses in realistic materials. By mapping strain gradients to long-wavelength phonons within the established theory of electron-phonon coupling, our approach captures the nonlocal quantum-mechanical effects of lattice deformations on nonlinear optical responses. Applying the framework to prototypical centrosymmetric materials, including Si, cubic $\rm SrTiO_3$, and monolayer black phosphorus, we demonstrate that a strain gradients of $10^5\sim10^6~\rm m^{-1}$ can induce flexo-second-harmonic generation and flexo-bulk photovoltaic effects comparable to the intrinsic responses of non-centrosymmetric crystals. Our work establishes a rigorous foundation for strain gradient engineering of light-matter interactions, opening new avenues for nanoscale optomechanics, optoelectronics, and beyond.

AI.tldr: 该文建立第一性原理框架，将应变梯度映射为长波声子并纳入电子-声子耦合理论，系统计算真实材料中的多种柔性光响应；在Si、立方SrTiO3和单层黑磷中证明10^5–10^6 m^-1应变梯度可诱导与天然非中心对称晶体本征响应相当的柔性二次谐波产生和柔性体光伏效应。
AI.motivation: 硅等高对称晶体因中心对称性禁戒偶数阶非线性光学响应，限制其在光子学与光电子学中的应用；应变梯度可破缺对称性并激活此类响应，但缺乏系统、微观且适用于真实材料的理论框架。
AI.method: 发展第一性原理方法，将应变梯度等效为长波声子，并基于既有电子-声子耦合理论处理晶格形变对非线性光学响应的非局域量子力学效应，从而系统评估真实材料中的多种柔性光响应。
AI.result: 应用于典型中心对称材料Si、立方SrTiO3和单层黑磷，表明10^5–10^6 m^-1的应变梯度可诱导柔性二次谐波产生和柔性体光伏效应，其量级可与非中心对称晶体的本征非线性响应相比。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为应变梯度调控光-物质相互作用奠定严格理论基础，并为纳米尺度光力学、光电子学等提供新途径。

title: Electron Wavefronts Capture Nanoscale Movies of Hypersound at Surfaces
summary: Acoustic waves transport mechanical energy and elastic strain through solids, with material composition and shape governing their propagation. In the gigahertz hypersound regime, acoustic wavelengths reach tens to hundreds of nanometres, comparable to nanoscale device dimensions. Harnessing these waves underpins high-frequency signal processing, sensing, electromagnetic coupling and quantum control. Acoustic metrology probes elastic modes and internal interfaces. Yet directly imaging how nanoscale acoustic waves interact with local structure remains challenging, requiring picometre displacement sensitivity combined with high spatiotemporal resolution. Here we demonstrate full-field imaging of laser-induced hypersound at surfaces using reflected electron wavefronts. We introduce ultrafast low-energy electron microscopy (ULEEM), exploiting the intrinsic surface sensitivity of few-electronvolt electrons. Coherent electron pulses down to femtosecond durations reflect from the topmost atomic layers, imprinting the evolving surface profile onto their wavefronts. Defocus converts phase variations into image contrast. In a thin van der Waals material, we image the thermoelastic generation and propagation of picometre-amplitude acoustic waves. Measured dispersion relations, interpreted through elastodynamic modelling, distinguish substrate-supported and locally detached regions, revealing how interfacial contact shapes propagation. Delayed wave emission reveals scattering at buried mechanical defects. Our results establish electron-wavefront imaging of nanoscale surface dynamics, enabling the exploration of ultrafast energy transport, structural transformations and coupled mechanical, electronic and magnetic phenomena.

AI.tldr: 该文利用超快低能电子显微镜（ULEEM）和反射电子波前成像，实现了对激光诱导GHz表面高超声速声波的全场纳米尺度成像，并解析了范德华薄片中皮米级声波的产生、传播、界面接触与缺陷散射。
AI.motivation: GHz高超声速声波波长可达数十至数百纳米，与纳米器件尺寸相当，对高频信号处理、传感、电磁耦合和量子调控很重要；但直接成像纳米声波与局域结构的相互作用需要同时具备皮米级位移灵敏度和高时空分辨，现有手段仍困难。
AI.method: 采用超快低能电子显微镜，利用几电子伏特电子的本征表面敏感性，使飞秒级相干电子脉冲从最表层原子反射；表面形貌变化印刻到电子波前上，通过离焦将相位变化转为图像衬度。在薄范德华材料中成像激光热弹性激发的皮米振幅声波，并结合弹性动力学建模解释色散关系。
AI.result: 实现了激光诱导表面高超声速声波的全场成像；测得色散关系可区分衬底支撑区与局域脱粘区，表明界面接触决定声波传播；延迟波发射揭示了埋藏机械缺陷处的散射。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了基于电子波前成像的纳米尺度表面动力学观测方法，为研究超快能量输运、结构相变以及机械-电子-磁性耦合现象提供了新途径。

title: On the Role of Atomic Mobility in the Polyamorphism of Metallic Glasses
summary: Understanding the microscopic mechanisms underlying polyamorphic transitions requires simultaneous knowledge of thermodynamic and structural evolution, which has remained experimentally inaccessible. Here, we combine chip-based fast differential scanning calorimetry with high-energy synchrotron X-ray diffraction to simultaneously probe the thermodynamic and structural evolution during the polyamorphic transition of a Pd-Ni-P metallic glass. Correlating heat-flow signals with the corresponding structural evolution during both heating and cooling reveals a direct relationship between thermodynamic evolution and medium-range structural ordering. Based on this relationship, we identify two distinct transition mechanisms. In the glassy state, the transition proceeds continuously through progressive medium-range ordering, accompanied by enhanced thermal stability and strongly temperature-dependent kinetics. In contrast, in the equilibrium supercooled liquid, the transition proceeds through the coexistence of distinct amorphous states, with only a weak temperature dependence of the kinetics. These findings show that atomic mobility governs the transformation pathway by coupling thermodynamic evolution to structural ordering, providing new insights into polyamorphic transitions in nonequilibrium amorphous systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过同时测量热力学与结构演化，揭示Pd-Ni-P金属玻璃多形转变的两类微观机制，并指出原子迁移率决定转变路径。
AI.motivation: 多形转变的微观机制需要同时了解热力学与结构演化，但此前实验上难以实现同步观测。
AI.method: 将芯片式快速差示扫描量热法与高能同步辐射X射线衍射结合，在升温和降温过程中同步探测Pd-Ni-P金属玻璃多形转变的热流信号与结构演化。
AI.result: 热流与结构演化的关联表明热力学演化与中程有序直接相关；玻璃态中转变通过渐进式中程有序连续进行，伴随热稳定性增强和强温度依赖动力学；平衡过冷液相中转变通过不同非晶态共存进行，动力学仅弱温度依赖。
AI.conclusion: 原子迁移率通过耦合热力学演化与结构有序化来决定转变路径，为理解非平衡非晶体系中的多形转变提供了新见解。

title: Side-Chain Engineering Controls Molecular Packing and Vertical Electron Transport in Discrete n-Type NDI-T2 Oligomers
summary: High-efficiency vertical charge transport in multilayer organic optoelectronic devices highly depends on molecular structure and arrangement. Using two T2-(NDI-T2)2 conjugated oligomers with ethylhexyl (EH) and octyldodecyl (OD) side chains as a model system, their effects on electron transport are investigated using, among other techniques, atomic force microscopy (AFM), conductive atomic force microscopy (C-AFM), grazing-incidence wide-angle X-ray scattering (GIWAXS), steady-state optical spectroscopy, and time-dependent density functional theory (TDDFT) calculations. The oligomers of both materials exhibit relatively disordered structures in the as-cast state, whereas annealing enhances structural order and leads to side-chain-dependent changes in molecular stacking. EH-based films show a smaller annealing-induced photoluminescence shift than OD-based films, suggesting less pronounced stacking and conformational rearrangements, consistent with TDDFT-supported exciton analysis. The current-voltage characteristics are analyzed using the space-charge-limited current (SCLC) model. After annealing, both materials exhibit improved vertical electron mobility. The EH-based films reach a maximum mobility of 1.2 x 10^-4 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1. The combined results suggest that the shorter EH side chains modify the out-of-plane packing environment and facilitate vertical electron transport.
