These results establish a structure-property relationship between side-chain structure, molecular order, exciton coupling and vertical mobility, providing a molecular design basis for optimising organic semiconductors through side-chain engineering.

AI.tldr: 以两种T2-(NDI-T2)2共轭寡聚物（EH与OD侧链）为模型，研究侧链结构对退火后分子堆积、激子耦合及垂直电子传输的影响；较短EH侧链改善面外堆积并促进垂直电子传输。
AI.motivation: 多层有机光电器件中的高效垂直电荷传输强烈依赖分子结构与排列，因此需要建立侧链结构、分子有序度、激子耦合与垂直迁移率之间的构效关系，为侧链工程优化有机半导体提供依据。
AI.method: 合成/采用带乙基己基（EH）和辛基十二烷基（OD）侧链的T2-(NDI-T2)2共轭寡聚物；结合AFM、C-AFM、GIWAXS、稳态光学光谱和时间依赖密度泛函理论（TDDFT）计算表征结构与激子性质；用空间电荷限制电流（SCLC）模型分析电流-电压特性并提取垂直电子迁移率。
AI.result: 两种材料铸态均较无序，退火增强结构有序并产生侧链依赖的分子堆叠变化；EH基薄膜退火诱导的光致发光位移小于OD基薄膜，表明其堆叠与构象重排较弱，与TDDFT支持的激子分析一致；退火后两者垂直电子迁移率均提高，EH基薄膜最高达1.2×10^-4 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1；结果表明较短EH侧链改变面外堆积环境并促进垂直电子传输。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了侧链结构、分子有序度、激子耦合与垂直迁移率之间的构效关系，证明侧链工程可调控有机半导体面外堆积和垂直电子传输，为分子设计优化提供依据。

title: Divalent Yb in the Ca$_3$Pd$_4$Bi$_8$ Structure Type: Crystal Growth and Physical Properties of Yb$_3$Pd$_4$Bi$_8$
summary: We report on the single-crystal growth, crystal structure, and physical properties of Yb$_3$Pd$_4$Bi$_8$. Single crystal x-ray diffraction shows that the material crystallizes in the Ca$_3$Pd$_4$Bi$_8$ structure-type at ambient conditions, described by orthorhombic symmetry $Pbam$. Magnetization measurements reveal a nearly isotropic diamagnetic response, indicating that Yb is stabilized in a non-magnetic divalent configuration. Electrical resistivity measurements show a metallic behavior. First-principles calculations including spin--orbit coupling describe a metal whose states at the Fermi level are dominated by Bi $6p$ orbitals, with a density of states within 1% of that of the isoelectronic compound Ca$_3$Pd$_4$Bi$_8$, consistent with a filled and chemically inert $4f$ shell. They further show that the nonsymmorphic symmetry of the crystal enforces fourfold-degenerate nodal lines on the Brillouin-zone boundary, four of which cross the Fermi level and give symmetry-enforced Dirac points with a linear transverse dispersion. Despite strong metallic and covalent bonding within the Pd-Bi network, Yb$_3$Pd$_4$Bi$_8$ is realized as a rare-earth analog of the Ca$_3$Pd$_4$Bi$_8$ structure type with divalent Yb ions. This result offers a potential avenue to discover other rare-earth analogs within this structural family.

AI.tldr: 报道了Yb3Pd4Bi8的单晶生长、晶体结构与物理性质；Yb为二价非磁态，材料呈金属性，第一性原理表明Bi 6p主导费米面，并由非简单空间群对称性强制产生四重简并节线及狄拉克点。
AI.motivation: 探索Ca3Pd4Bi8结构型中的稀土类似物，理解填充4f壳层、Yb价态与金属性/拓扑电子结构之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用单晶X射线衍射确定结构，进行磁化率和电阻率测量，并结合包含自旋-轨道耦合的第一性原理计算电子结构。
AI.result: Yb3Pd4Bi8在常压下以正交Pbam对称性的Ca3Pd4Bi8结构型结晶；磁化显示近各向同性抗磁性，表明Yb为稳定二价非磁态；电阻率显示金属行为；计算表明费米能级态主要由Bi 6p轨道贡献，态密度与同电子化合物Ca3Pd4Bi8相差在1%以内，并在布里渊区边界给出四重简并节线，其中四条穿过费米能级并形成具有线性横向色散的对称性强制狄拉克点。
AI.conclusion: Yb3Pd4Bi8被实现为Ca3Pd4Bi8结构型的稀有稀土类似物，其中Yb为二价；该结果为在该结构家族中寻找其他稀土类似物提供了途径。

title: Modification of optical properties in ultrathin ALD-grown NbN layers using oxygen plasma treatment
summary: NbN thin films with a nominal thickness of 10 nm were grown by atomic layer deposition (ALD) on Al$_2$O$_3$-buffered Si substrates and treated with oxygen plasma for 0 s (untreated), 20 s, 40 s, and 60 s to investigate oxygen-induced changes in their optical properties. Spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE) measurements were performed before and after oxygen plasma treatment over the ultraviolet-visible-near-infrared (1.24-6.20 eV) and infrared (0.041-0.827 eV) spectral ranges. Film thickness determined by X-ray reflectivity (XRR) was used as a fixed parameter in the optical modeling to extract the dielectric function, optical constants, and effective free-carrier concentration. We observed the emergence of a distinct absorption feature near 4.9 eV following oxygen plasma treatment, consistent with the oxidation of the NbN surface and the resulting change in its optical properties. Increasing the treatment time from 0 to 60 s reduced the effective carrier concentration from $1.20 \times 10^{22}$ to $1.03 \times 10^{22}$ cm$^{-3}$ and the effective carrier mobility from 2.44 to 2.27 cm$^2$ V$^{-1}$ s$^{-1}$. The obtained results provide a basis for understanding the effects of oxygen plasma treatment on NbN thin films.

AI.tldr: 研究了氧等离子体处理对ALD生长10 nm NbN薄膜光学性质的影响：处理后在约4.9 eV出现吸收特征，并降低有效载流子浓度和迁移率。
AI.motivation: NbN薄膜在器件应用中可能受氧等离子体工艺影响，需要理解氧化对NbN光学性质和自由载流子行为的作用。
AI.method: 在Al2O3缓冲Si衬底上用原子层沉积生长名义厚度10 nm的NbN薄膜，分别进行0、20、40、60 s氧等离子体处理；用光谱椭偏仪在紫外-可见-近红外（1.24-6.20 eV）和红外（0.041-0.827 eV）范围测量，并以XRR确定的膜厚作为固定参数进行光学建模，提取介电函数、光学常数和有效自由载流子浓度。
AI.result: 氧等离子体处理后，在约4.9 eV附近出现明显吸收特征，与NbN表面氧化及其光学性质变化一致；处理时间从0增至60 s时，有效载流子浓度由1.20×10^22降至1.03×10^22 cm^-3，有效载流子迁移率由2.44降至2.27 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了氧等离子体处理导致的NbN表面氧化及自由载流子性质退化，为理解氧等离子体对NbN薄膜光学性质的影响提供了基础。

title: High-quality, deep formation and identification of oxygen-vacancy defects in silicon carbide
summary: Optically addressable paramagnetic defects in silicon carbide (SiC) are attractive for scalable quantum technologies such as quantum sensing. PL5, PL6, and PL7 are promising defects for their high brightness and spin-readout contrast. Although generation by oxygen implantation has been reported very recently, nonuniform spin and optical properties and the limited generation depth of implanted defects hinder both high-sensitivity sensing and conclusive microscopic identification. Here we engineer high-quality defects by decoupling oxygen incorporation and defect formation, realizing highly homogeneous spin-resonance frequencies as well as narrow optical linewidths and long T2* coherence time. Further, we demonstrate defect formation beyond the ion range utilizing oxygen diffusion, exceptional among impurities in SiC. We further provide hyperfine-interaction statistics of 17O and host nuclei across many PL6 defects, making the oxygen-vacancy origin conclusive. Together, the microscopic identification and the demonstrated formation route establish a foundation for developing the oxygen-vacancy spin defect into a versatile quantum platform.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过解耦氧掺入与缺陷形成，制备出高质量SiC氧空位自旋缺陷，并确认PL6的氧空位起源。
AI.motivation: SiC中PL5、PL6、PL7等可光学寻址顺磁缺陷亮度高、自旋读出对比度好，但氧注入生成方式存在自旋/光学性质不均、生成深度受限等问题，阻碍高灵敏量子传感和微观鉴定。
AI.method: 将氧掺入与缺陷形成过程解耦以工程化高质量缺陷；利用氧扩散实现超出离子注入范围的缺陷形成；并对多个PL6缺陷中17O及宿主核的超精细相互作用进行统计。
AI.result: 获得高度均匀的自旋共振频率、窄光学线宽和长T2*相干时间；证明氧可在离子射程之外扩散形成缺陷；超精细相互作用统计使PL6的氧空位起源得到确证。
AI.conclusion: 该研究实现了PL6缺陷的微观鉴定和可控形成路线，为将SiC氧空位自旋缺陷发展为通用量子平台奠定基础。

title: Probing the limits of forward screening and inverse design of crystal materials
summary: Crystal materials are designed either by screening known crystals for a target property or by generating new crystals with that property. Both routes are judged against public databases of known crystals, but these databases name the same crystal differently. Several materials announced as new by recent generative and autonomous discovery campaigns have since proved to be known phases or close variants of them. The limits of both routes remain unmeasured. Here we probe them by matching the crystals of 55 databases by structure into one self-extending database of 14.6 million crystals and 131.8 million property values, each traced to its source. Only 4.5% of its crystal-property pairs carry a value. To fill the empty pairs, we developed CGTNet, an equivariant graph transformer with state-of-the-art accuracy on several tasks of two public benchmarks. Trained on each task, it forms a library of property models whose predictions we release. The reach of forward screening has been underestimated. Known crystals hold tens of thousands of ultra-incompressible candidates without a recorded bulk modulus, and a post hoc audit of synthesis evidence finds among them ReN2, whose bulk modulus was measured at 428 GPa. The novelty claimed for inverse design has been overestimated. At an equal verification budget, a stiffness-conditioned generator returned more stiff hits than screening (100 versus 55), but all contained osmium and 82 repeated recorded compositions. Integrating and completing the databases of known crystals therefore moves the limits of both routes: it widens what screening can reach and sets the reference against which generated crystals are judged new.

AI.tldr: 该文通过结构匹配整合55个晶体数据库并补全性质，重新界定正向筛选与逆向生成的能力边界。
AI.motivation: 晶体数据库对同一晶体命名不一致，近期生成式/自主发现宣称的新相常被证明是已知相或近似变体，且筛选与生成路线的能力上限均未被量化。
AI.method: 将55个数据库按结构匹配为包含1460万晶体和1.318亿性质值、可追溯来源的自扩展数据库；仅4.5%的晶体-性质对已有值。开发CGTNet——等变图Transformer，在两个公开基准的多项任务上达到SOTA；按任务训练形成性质模型库并发布预测。
AI.result: 正向筛选被低估：已知晶体中有数万个无体模量记录的超不可压缩候选，事后合成证据审计发现ReN2，其体模量实测428 GPa。逆向设计的新颖性被高估：相同验证预算下，刚度条件生成器返回100个刚性命中，筛选为55个，但生成命中均含锇且82个重复已有组成。
AI.conclusion: 整合并补全已知晶体数据库可移动两条路线的边界：既拓宽筛选可达范围，也为判断生成晶体是否真正新颖提供参照。

title: On the Spontaneous Structural Reconstructions of Chalcogen-Depleted MoS$_2$, MoSe$_2$, and Janus MoSSe Monolayers
summary: Removing one chalcogen layer from a transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayer leaves an undercoordinated sheet that reconstructs as the remaining chalcogen atoms cross the metal plane. Here, we combine \textit{ab initio} and reactive molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of depleted MoS$_2$, MoSe$_2$, and Janus MoSSe, examining each remaining chalcogen on two parent lattices, to show that the remaining chalcogen type determines the structural reconstruction, with only a minor influence from the parent lattice. In \textit{ab initio} trajectories of the Janus-derived sheets, Se crosses the Mo plane already at 300~K, whereas S stays in place at 300~K and the sheet reconstructs only at 900~K. With a free in-plane cell, the crossings precede an anisotropic lattice contraction, which therefore results from the structural reconstruction. Reactive MD simulations of 50~nm sheets show that, when S remains, the Mo lattice stays crystalline in nanometric domains that disappear with time and temperature, with pores/holes at 900~K. In contrast, when Se remains, the Mo lattice loses crystalline order within the first picosecond, and 36--39\% of the Se atoms cross at every temperature. In a depleted lateral MoS$_2$/MoSe$_2$ heterostructure, both modes coexist in one sheet, each half reconstructing like its single-chalcogen counterpart, suggesting chalcogen patterning as a route to define crystalline and disordered regions in a single monolayer.

AI.tldr: depleted TMD 单层中剩余硫族元素种类决定结构重构：Se 易跨越 Mo 平面并导致快速无序化，S 则保持较稳定 crystalline 畴，且可在横向异质结中实现晶态/无序区域图案化。
AI.motivation: 去除过渡金属硫族化物单层的一层硫族原子会形成配位不足的薄片，其剩余硫族原子可能跨越金属平面发生重构；需要厘清剩余硫族种类与母晶格对重构行为、晶格收缩和有序性的影响。
AI.method: 结合 ab initio 与反应分子动力学模拟，研究 depleted MoS2、MoSe2 和 Janus MoSSe，并考察每种剩余硫族原子在两种母晶格上的行为；使用自由面内晶胞、50 nm 薄片以及 depleted 横向 MoS2/MoSe2 异质结构。
AI.result: ab initio 轨迹显示 Janus 衍生薄片中 Se 在 300 K 即跨越 Mo 平面，而 S 在 300 K 保持原位、900 K 才重构；自由面内晶胞下跨越先于各向异性晶格收缩，说明收缩源于结构重构。反应 MD 中，S 剩余时 Mo 晶格在纳米畴内保持 crystalline，但畴随时间和温度消失，900 K 出现孔洞；Se 剩余时 Mo 晶格在首个皮秒内失去 crystalline 有序，且各温度下 36–39% Se 原子发生跨越。depleted 横向 MoS2/MoSe2 异质结构中两种模式共存，各半区类似其单硫族对应体系。
AI.conclusion: 剩余硫族元素类型是决定 depleted TMD 薄片重构与有序性的主要因素，母晶格影响较小；横向硫族图案化可用于在单一单层中定义 crystalline 与无序区域。

title: Controlled Fabrication of Uniform Columnar Porous GaN Architectures by Electrochemical Etching
summary: Electrochemical etching (ECE) of n-type c-plane GaN enables the formation of porous architectures capable of enhancing the performance of optoelectronic devices and broadening the range of possible GaN applications. Here, we demonstrate that the addition of NaOH to Na2C2O4 (and other non-acidic etchant solutions) directs ECE toward the formation of nanoscale, vertically aligned, highly uniform columnar pore morphologies with relatively limited surface roughening. By varying the NaOH concentration within mixed electrolyte systems, the columnar pore shape, diameter, spacing, and bulk and surface porosity can be readily tuned. In addition to manually mixing NaOH with another etchant, aqueous basic electrolytes such as Na2CO3 and Na3PO4, each inherently containing significant hydroxide concentration through hydrolysis, also produce similar columnar pore morphologies, indicating that hydroxide plays the key role in directing the vertical pore growth. Chronoamperometry and pore structure analysis reveals that the mixed hydroxide-containing electrolyte systems exhibit a distinct, new ECE mechanism rather than a simple superposition of the individual ECE behaviour of each anion present. This work provides significant insight into the ECE mechanism for porous GaN, which is proposed to contain multiple reaction steps where hydroxide anions are involved in the formation of a reactive intermediate. These findings establish a versatile and controllable route for engineering columnar porous GaN architectures, offering significant advancement in applications requiring high porosity, ordered, and bespoke structures.

AI.tldr: 在n型c面GaN的电化学刻蚀（ECE）中，向Na2C2O4等非酸性刻蚀液加入NaOH可定向形成纳米级、垂直排列、高度均匀的柱状孔，并可通过碱浓度调控孔形貌与孔隙率。
AI.motivation: 多孔GaN可提升光电器件性能并拓展GaN应用，但需要可控的孔结构形貌及对ECE机理的理解；研究旨在通过含氢氧根混合电解液实现柱状多孔结构的可控制备并揭示其机制。
AI.method: 对n型c面GaN进行ECE，在Na2C2O4等刻蚀液中添加不同浓度NaOH，并采用Na2CO3、Na3PO4等本征含氢氧根的碱性电解液；结合计时电流法和孔结构分析表征形貌与刻蚀行为。
AI.result: NaOH使ECE趋向于形成纳米级、垂直取向、均匀的柱状孔，表面粗化有限；改变NaOH浓度可调节柱状孔形状、直径、间距及体/表面孔隙率。Na2CO3和Na3PO4也产生类似柱状孔，表明氢氧根是引导垂直孔生长的关键。混合含氢氧根电解液表现出不同于各阴离子单独ECE简单叠加的新机制，推测涉及氢氧根参与形成反应性中间体的多步反应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了多孔GaN的ECE机理，并建立了可调、可控的柱状多孔GaN制备路线，有利于高孔隙率、有序及定制结构相关应用。

title: Ginzburg-Landau Theory with Elastic Incompatibility Describes the Liquid-G-phase-Crystal State Diagram
summary: We derive a mechanically consistent Ginzburg-Landau theory for the metastable heterogeneous G state reported in deeply undercooled metallic liquids. The central result is that type-II-like mixed-state physics can emerge structurally with the random internal stress field playing the role of the magnetic field. Frozen eigenstrain due to elastic incompatibility between ordered cores and the amorphous matrix generates incompatible stress, while the non-affine internal strain in the liquid-like matrix in between the ordered cores relaxes that stress over a finite screening length $\lambda_\sigma$ (analogous to the London length in the superconducting problem). Structural order heals over a distinct mechanically-dressed length $\xi_G$; their ratio $\kappa_G=\lambda_\sigma/\xi_G$ provides the structural counterpart of the Ginzburg-Landau parameter. Because the matrix is transiently rigid yet locally relaxational only over an intermediate time window, the same mechanism selects crystal for slow protocols, a heterogeneous G state at intermediate rates, and a homogeneous L-like glass under rapid arrest. Residual incompatibility frustrates coarsening, allowing finite ordered cores and screened, orientation-dependent core interactions. The resulting texture is an inverted Abrikosov analogue: structural order resides in the cores, whereas incompatible-stress screening is carried by the surrounding disordered matrix. The theory yields direct simulation and experimental tests through stress-decay, structural-healing, non-affine-susceptibility, and kinetic measurements.

AI.tldr: 该文为深过冷金属液体中瞬态异质G态建立力学自洽的Ginzburg-Landau理论，提出内部随机应力可类比磁场，导致结构上的II型混合态物理。
AI.motivation: 解释深过冷金属液体中实验报道的亚稳异质G态，并统一理解不同冷却/固化速率下晶体、异质G态与类玻璃L态的选择机制。
AI.method: 引入有序核与无序基体间弹性不兼容产生的冻结本征应变，以液态基体非仿射内应变对不相容应力进行有限屏蔽；定义屏蔽长度λσ、结构愈合长度ξG及结构GL参数κG=λσ/ξG，并考虑基体在中间时间窗口内的瞬态刚性与局部弛豫。
AI.result: 理论表明可形成结构序位于有序核、应力屏蔽由无序基体承担的“倒置Abrikosov”织构；残余不相容抑制粗化，产生有限尺寸有序核及屏蔽的取向依赖核间相互作用；同一机制可随协议速率选择晶体、异质G态或均匀L类玻璃。
AI.conclusion: 该框架给出应力衰减、结构愈合、非仿射磁化率和动力学测量等可直接检验的模拟与实验判据，为深过冷液体中的异质结构有序提供统一力学GL描述。

title: Rationalizing charge transfer: a single-molecule case study across three distinct surfaces
summary: Organic molecules are versatile building blocks for the formation of complex low-dimensional nanostructures on surfaces. Recently, interest has grown in translating on-surface synthetic protocols from noble metal surfaces to insulating surfaces, which offer technological relevance, and to magnetic or superconducting surfaces, which offer new routes to correlated phases. It is important, therefore, to understand how these alternative surfaces may alter the properties of adsorbates through processes like charge transfer and screening. Evidence for charge transfer is often obtained experimentally via scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) and spectroscopy (STS), and theoretically via density functional theory (DFT). In this work, we systematically compare the properties of isolated macrocyclic emeraldine (Me$_6$) molecules on three different surfaces: metallic Au(111), a semiconducting ferromagnetic monolayer of FeCl$_2$, and a cleaved superconducting surface of bulk 2H-NbSe$_2$. We show that STS and DFT alone are insufficient to quantify charge transfer for these cases. Instead, we complement these methods with Kelvin probe force microscopy (KPFM) measurements and model Hamiltonian calculations to demonstrate that on Au(111) and FeCl$_2$, Me$_6$ molecules donate a single electron to the substrate, whereas on NbSe$_2$ two electrons are transferred from molecule to substrate. Our work provides insight into the interplay of charge transfer, screening, and molecule-substrate coupling, and develops experimental and theoretical methods for comparing the properties of adsorbates across different surfaces for future studies.

AI.tldr: 该文系统比较了Me$_6$分子在Au(111)、FeCl$_2$单层和2H-NbSe$_2$表面的电荷转移，发现仅靠STS与DFT不足以定量，需结合KPFM和模型哈密顿量。
AI.motivation: 将表面合成从贵金属拓展到绝缘、磁性或超导表面时，需理解不同基底如何通过电荷转移和屏蔽改变吸附分子性质。
AI.method: 以孤立大环emeraldine（Me$_6$）分子为对象，在Au(111)、铁磁性半导体FeCl$_2$单层和超导2H-NbSe$_2$解理面上结合STM/STS、DFT、KPFM及模型哈密顿量计算进行比较。
AI.result: STS和DFT单独无法可靠量化电荷转移；KPFM与模型计算表明，在Au(111)和FeCl$_2$上Me$_6$向基底转移一个电子，而在NbSe$_2$上转移两个电子。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了电荷转移、屏蔽和分子-基底耦合的相互作用，并为跨不同表面比较吸附物性质建立了实验与理论方法。

title: Combining Simulations and Spectroscopy to Design Protective Coatings on Sulfide Solid Electrolytes
summary: Sulfide solid electrolytes are attractive for all-solid-state batteries because of their high Li-ion conductivity and favorable processability, but their practical use is limited by electrochemical instability and moisture-induced degradation. Molecular surface coatings offer a scalable strategy to improve humidity tolerance and interfacial stability, yet there is limited understanding of the molecular-level factors governing surface interactions. By combining large-scale atomistic simulations enabled by a machine-learning potential with targeted experiments, we present a comprehensive framework for designing molecular coatings on Li$_6$PS$_5$Cl (LPSCl). Using a PET-MAD interatomic potential fine-tuned on an r$^2$SCAN reference dataset covering LPSCl surfaces, molecular adsorbates, and their interactions, we model surface adsorption of carboxylic (CA), sulfonic (SA), and phosphonic (PA) acids with alkyl chains of varying lengths and the interaction of these coated surfaces with water at finite temperature. The simulations show that lithiated head groups generally exhibit more favorable adsorption energies. Impedance spectroscopy shows that the lithiated coatings maintain 40--55\% of the initial ionic conductivity after powder processing. While adsorption strength is largely controlled by head-group chemistry and lithiation state, coating morphology depends primarily on alkyl-chain length and surface coverage. In particular, long-chain lithiated carboxylates form dense, brush-like hydrophobic layers that reduce water access to reactive Li surface sites, with protection setting in at a coating thickness of approximately 0.8 nm. Consistent with these predictions, longer carboxylate chains suppress H$_2$S evolution more effectively. Because thicker coatings also hinder Li-ion transport, intermediate chain lengths offer the best balance between moisture protection and ionic conductivity.

AI.tldr: 该工作结合机器学习势函数大规模原子模拟与实验，建立了Li6PS5Cl硫化物固态电解质分子表面涂层设计框架，揭示头基化学、锂化状态、烷基链长和覆盖度对吸附、形貌、疏水性、H2S抑制及离子传输的影响。
AI.motivation: 硫化物固态电解质具有高锂离子导率和良好加工性，但电化学不稳定和湿气诱导降解限制其应用；分子表面涂层可提升耐湿性和界面稳定性，但缺乏对分子级表面相互作用调控因素的系统理解。
AI.method: 构建并微调PET-MAD机器学习原子间势，参考数据覆盖LPSCl表面、分子吸附物及其相互作用，基于r2SCAN数据集进行大规模原子模拟；研究羧酸、磺酸和膦酸类分子（不同烷基链长）在LPSCl表面的吸附，以及有限温度下涂层表面与水的相互作用；结合阻抗谱和H2S演化实验验证。
AI.result: 锂化头基通常具有更有利的吸附能；粉末加工后锂化涂层保留初始离子导率的40–55%。吸附强度主要由头基化学和锂化状态决定，涂层形貌主要由烷基链长和表面覆盖度决定。长链锂化羧酸盐形成致密刷状疏水层，减少水接触反应性Li表面位点，约0.8 nm厚度开始提供保护；较长羧酸盐链更有效抑制H2S生成，但厚涂层阻碍锂离子传输。
AI.conclusion: 分子涂层设计需在耐湿保护与离子传导之间权衡；中等烷基链长的锂化羧酸盐涂层可实现最佳平衡，为LPSCl硫化物固态电解质表面涂层理性设计提供依据。

title: CO2-Induced Shifts in the Confined Phase Transformation of CH4 in Metal-Organic Frameworks
summary: A sharp increase in gas uptake over a narrow pressure range can occur for fluids confined in nanoporous materials such as metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), reflecting a transformation between distinct adsorption states, often accompanied by the existence of metastable states. Understanding how co-adsorbed species modify this behavior is important for predicting and optimizing gas storage and separation. Here, we investigate the effect of CO2 on the adsorption transformation of confined CH4 in rigid IRMOF-1 and IRMOF-8. Transition-Matrix Monte Carlo (TMMC) simulations were performed for systems containing 0-75 and 0-150 CO2 molecules in IRMOF-1 and IRMOF-8, respectively. While the addition of CO2 decreases the maximum CH4 uptake, consistent with competition for pore space, remarkably, the presence of CO2 significantly shifts the discontinuity in the CH4 adsorption isotherm to substantially lower pressures relative to the pure CH4 system. This promotion of the high-density CH4 phase at lower pressures demonstrates that CO2 substantially alters the thermodynamic landscape governing confined CH4 through changes in both fluid-fluid and fluid-framework interactions. These results establish CO2 as a thermodynamic modifier of confined CH4 behavior and suggest that controlled co-adsorption provides a means of tuning adsorption transformations in nanoporous materials.

AI.tldr: 该文通过TMMC模拟研究CO2对刚性IRMOF-1和IRMOF-8中受限CH4吸附转变的影响，发现CO2虽降低CH4最大吸附量，却显著将CH4等温线的不连续转变移至更低压力，促进高密度CH4相生成。
AI.motivation: 纳米多孔材料中受限流体的吸附等温线可在窄压力范围内出现气体吸附量陡增，反映不同吸附态之间的转变并伴随亚稳态；理解共吸附组分如何改变该行为，对预测和优化气体储存与分离具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用Transition-Matrix Monte Carlo（TMMC）模拟，在刚性IRMOF-1和IRMOF-8中分别引入0–75和0–150个CO2分子，考察CO2对受限CH4吸附转变的影响。
AI.result: 加入CO2会因孔空间竞争而降低CH4最大吸附量；但CO2显著将CH4吸附等温线中的不连续性移至远低于纯CH4体系的压力，从而在更低压力下促进高密度CH4相。这表明CO2通过改变流体-流体和流体-骨架相互作用，显著重塑受限CH4的热力学景观。
AI.conclusion: CO2可作为受限CH4行为的热力学调节剂，受控共吸附为调控纳米多孔材料中的吸附转变提供了一种手段。

title: Vacancy-enhanced Li solid-solution anodes for solid-state batteries: computational screening enabling high critical current density
summary: Sluggish vacancy-mediated self-diffusion in lithium metal limits the critical current density (CCD) of Li anodes in solid-state batteries by promoting interfacial void formation during stripping. To enhance the effective vacancy concentration while preserving the bcc Li host, we screen 50 substitutional solutes using density functional theory (DFT) within a funnel based on automatic phase diagram construction, solution energies, solute-vacancy binding energies, and experimental solubility limits. Using an adaptation of the Lomer model for the dilute limit, we show that only Ag, Ge, and Cd solid solutions are predicted to reach $1~\mathrm{mA~cm^{-2}}$ within their solubility limits. The thermodynamically estimated CCD of Ag at $\sim 9$ at.% reaches $\sim 4~\mathrm{mA~cm^{-2}}$ at a theoretical capacity of $1522~\mathrm{mAh~g^{-1}}$. Migration barrier calculations indicate that the enhancement may be partially offset by vacancy trapping, necessitating further validation via molecular dynamics simulations. Notably, Hume-Rothery rules alone prove insufficient as prefilters, whereas machine-learning models trained on the DFT data can eliminate most unsuitable solutes early in the funnel and extend the workflow to related solid-solution searches.

AI.tldr: 该文通过DFT筛选50种替代溶质，寻找可在保持bcc Li基体的同时提高有效空位浓度、从而提升锂金属负极临界电流密度（CCD）的固溶元素。
AI.motivation: 锂金属中空位介导的自扩散迟缓会在剥离过程中促进界面空洞形成，限制固态电池Li负极的CCD；目标是在不破坏bcc Li宿主的前提下提高有效空位浓度。
AI.method: 采用基于自动相图构建、固溶能、溶质-空位结合能和实验溶解度极限的漏斗式DFT筛选；用稀释极限下改进的Lomer模型估计CCD，并计算迁移势垒；指出需分子动力学进一步验证，同时评估Hume-Rothery规则和基于DFT数据的机器学习模型作为预筛选工具。
AI.result: 仅Ag、Ge、Cd固溶体被预测可在其溶解度极限内达到1 mA cm^-2；Ag在约9 at.%时热力学估计CCD约4 mA cm^-2（理论容量1522 mAh g^-1）。迁移势垒计算表明空位捕获可能部分抵消提升效果。Hume-Rothery规则单独作为预筛选不足，而DFT训练的机器学习模型可早期剔除大多数不合适溶质并扩展至相关固溶体搜索。
AI.conclusion: Ag、Ge、Cd是有前景的固溶候选，其中Ag提升CCD潜力最大，但空位捕获效应需通过分子动力学等进一步验证；机器学习可增强此类固溶体筛选流程。

title: Low-energy collective electronic excitations in a gold monolayer
summary: The low-energy plasmonic properties of a free-standing Au(111) monolayer, frequently referred to as goldene, are investigated by time-dependent density functional theory in the random phase approximation. In the evaluation of dielectric and loss functions the first-principle band structure characterized by a single $s-p$ energy band at the Fermi level is taken into account. In this system with apparently simple band structure around the Fermi surface the calculations show the presence, besides the standard two-dimensional (2D) plasmon mode, at even lower energies of three anomalous branches in the momentum-energy region usually assigned to incoherent electron-hole pairs. This is an unexpected result since the electronic system of the gold monolayer is characterized by a single energy band crossing the Fermi level. The dispersion of these anomalous plasmonic branches is strongly anisotropic in-plane and gapless. A general feature is that at small in-plane momentum transfers the modes have a sound-like dispersion in certain momentum directions. We rely the appearance of these anomalous modes to a notable deviation of the Fermi surface of a gold monolayer from a circular shape. As a result of its almost perfect hexagon shape, there is possibility to realize in a {\it single} electronic energy band a scenario of a multi-component electron system with the carrier groups moving with different Fermi velocities in certain momentum directions. The found modes correspond to the out-of-phase charge oscillations of the carriers at different sides of the hexagonal Fermi surface. Hence our work presents evidence how in a metal system with apparently simple band structure around the Fermi level its shape can result in conversion of single-particle charge excitations into collective charge excitations.

AI.tldr: TDDFT-RPA计算表明，自支撑Au(111)单层除常规二维等离激元外还存在三条低能反常等离激元分支，其起源于近六边形费米面导致的单带多分量电子行为。
AI.motivation: 研究金烯的低能等离激元性质，并检验费米面附近看似简单的单带电子结构能否产生非常规集体电荷激发。
AI.method: 采用随机相近似下的含时密度泛函理论，结合第一性原理能带结构计算介电函数和损失函数。
AI.result: 在费米面附近仅有一条s-p带的情况下，除标准二维等离激元外，在通常归为无相干电子-空穴对的动量-能量区域发现三条反常分支；这些分支无能隙、面内强各向异性，并在小动量转移下沿某些方向呈声学型色散。作者将其归因于Au(111)单层费米面由圆形显著偏离为近六边形，使同一能带中费米面不同侧的载流子具有不同费米速度并发生反相电荷振荡。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，即使金属费米面附近能带结构看似简单，其费米面形状也可将单粒子电荷激发转化为集体电荷激发，并在单一电子能带中实现多分量电子体系场景。

title: Heterogeneous superconductivity emerging from a charge-stripe state in kagome lattices
summary: Charge density wave (CDW) and superconductivity have long been recognized as competing orders. However, recent achievements establish that the interplay between these two collective electronic phenomena can be more perplexing, with emergent phenomena arising from their cooperation. Here we report a distinctive case of the kagome superconductors CsV3Sb5-xSnx, in which the characteristics of superconductivity evolve in accordance with the form of CDW order. As the triple-Q CDW in CsV3Sb5 transforms to a short-range stripelike CDW at xc = 0.07, a sudden change in superconducting properties occurs concomitantly. A combination of thermodynamic, electrical transport and scanning tunneling microscopy experiments reveals a heterogeneous superconducting state beyond xc: the superconducting gap exhibits pronounced spatial variation, in conformity with a distribution of critical temperature and the resulted superconducting precursor effects. Moreover, abundant normal fluid persists deep into the superconducting state, as evidenced by remnants of electronic specific heat and zero-energy quasiparticle interference. These observations are unrelated to the chemical inhomogeneity and residual strain effect introduced by Sn substitution. Instead, they emulate the phenomenology that a sign-changing superconducting order parameter is subject to strong pair-breaking scattering with the short-range charge stripes and hence reflect the unconventional nature of superconductivity developing inside the charge-stripe state.

AI.tldr: 在kagome超导体CsV3Sb5-xSnx中，CDW序从三重Q型转变为短程条纹型时，超导态同步由均匀态演化为异质态，并表现出可能源于符号变化序参量受条纹涨落强散射的非传统超导特征。
AI.motivation: 传统上CDW与超导被视为竞争序，但近期研究表明二者合作可产生新兴现象；本文旨在探究CDW序形式变化如何影响超导态及其微观机制。
AI.method: 通过Sn替代调控CsV3Sb5-xSnx体系，在xc=0.07处实现三重Q CDW向短程条纹CDW转变，并结合热力学、电输运和扫描隧道显微镜测量超导能隙、临界温度分布、比热和准粒子干涉。
AI.result: 在xc附近超导性质突然改变；超过xc后出现异质超导态，超导能隙空间不均一，Tc呈分布并伴随超导前兆效应；深超导态中仍有大量正常流体，表现为电子比热残余和零能准粒子干涉。这些现象不能归因于化学不均匀或残余应变。
AI.conclusion: 短程电荷条纹对符号变化超导序参量造成强配对破坏散射，可解释观测到的异质超导与正常流体残留，表明条纹CDW态中发展出的超导具有非传统性质。

title: Compass Correlations in a Square-Lattice Magnet
summary: The square-lattice compass model is a paradigm of bond-dependent frustration, yet experimental evidence for its characteristic spin correlations has remained elusive. Here we identify compass correlations in the square-lattice intermetallic ErRu$_2$Si$_2$ using single-crystal neutron diffuse scattering. Comparative measurements on the isostructural compounds NdRu$_2$Si$_2$ and ErRu$_2$Si$_2$ reveal a pronounced contrast between nearly uniform diffuse rings in the former and strong intensity modulation between Brillouin zones in the latter. Through the magnetic neutron polarization factor, this modulation reveals compass correlations that couple moment orientation to the correlation wavevector. Crystal-field spectroscopy identifies four preferred in-plane orientations for the Er$^{3+}$ moments. A minimal compass-Heisenberg model incorporating this anisotropy quantitatively reproduces the diffuse scattering and accounts for the double-$Q$ vortex-antivortex ground state. Fits with the compass couplings fixed at values set by the dipolar energy scale retain good agreement with the data, supporting a substantial dipolar contribution to the bond-dependent interactions. Our results establish a square-lattice platform for compass physics and suggest that dipolar interactions, acting together with local crystal-field anisotropy, can shape directional magnetic correlations alongside conduction-electron-mediated exchange.

AI.tldr: 该文利用单晶中子漫散射在方格子金属间化合物 ErRu$_2$Si$_2$ 中识别出 compass 自旋关联，并用 compass-Heisenberg 模型解释其漫散射与双 Q 涡旋-反涡旋基态。
AI.motivation: 方格子 compass 模型是键依赖阻挫的范例，但其特征自旋关联长期缺乏实验证据；作者旨在寻找并表征这类 compass 关联。
AI.method: 对同构化合物 NdRu$_2$Si$_2$ 与 ErRu$_2$Si$_2$ 进行单晶中子漫散射对比测量，利用磁性中子极化因子提取关联波矢与磁矩取向耦合信息；结合晶体场谱学确定 Er$^{3+}$ 面内四个优势取向，并构建包含该各向异性的最小 compass-Heisenberg 模型拟合数据。
AI.result: NdRu$_2$Si$_2$ 呈现近乎均匀的漫散射环，而 ErRu$_2$Si$_2$ 在布里渊区之间表现出强烈强度调制；该调制揭示 compass 关联。模型定量重现漫散射并解释双 Q 涡旋-反涡旋基态；将 compass 耦合固定为由偶极能标设定的值时仍与数据吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: ErRu$_2$Si$_2$ 提供了研究方格子 compass 物理的实验平台；局域晶体场各向异性与偶极相互作用可协同传导电子介导交换，塑造方向性磁关联，并表明偶极作用对键依赖相互作用有重要贡献。

title: Triplon dynamics from partial Kondo screening in frustrated heavy-fermion systems
summary: The partially disordered (PD) phase, in which magnetically ordered and Kondo-screened sites coexist, has been proposed as a possible ground state of geometrically frustrated heavy-fermion systems. We investigate its dynamical properties in the half-filled periodic Anderson model on a triangular lattice by calculating the dynamical spin susceptibility within the random-phase approximation built on a self-consistent Hartree-Fock solution. We show that successive quantum phase transitions from the Kondo-insulating phase to the PD phase and to a magnetically ordered phase are driven by the condensation of triplon modes originating predominantly from the Kondo-screened sites. In the PD phase, magnons and triplons coexist and hybridize, leading to characteristic level repulsion in the excitation spectrum. These results reveal how triplet excitations evolve into collective magnetic modes across the successive phase transitions and highlight the dynamical interplay between magnetic order and Kondo screening in frustrated heavy-fermion systems.

AI.tldr: 该文用三角晶格半满周期Anderson模型研究部分无序（PD）相的动力学性质，发现连续量子相变由Kondo屏蔽位点主导的三重子模式凝聚驱动，且PD相中磁振子与三重子共存并杂化。
AI.motivation: 几何阻挫重费米子系统中，磁有序与Kondo屏蔽共存的PD相被提出为可能基态，但其动力学性质及磁序与Kondo屏蔽的相互作用尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在三角晶格半满周期Anderson模型上，基于自洽Hartree-Fock解并在随机相近似（RPA）下计算动力学自旋磁化率。
AI.result: 从Kondo绝缘相到PD相再到磁有序相存在连续量子相变，主要由Kondo屏蔽位点产生的三重子模式凝聚驱动；PD相中磁振子与三重子共存并杂化，激发谱出现特征性的能级排斥。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了三重态激发如何跨越连续相变演化为集体磁模式，并突出了阻挫重费米子系统中磁有序与Kondo屏蔽之间的动力学互作。

title: Strain-tunable van Hove singularity and superconducting dome in monolayer kagome metal CsTi$_3$Bi$_5$
summary: The recently discovered titanium-based kagome metal CsTi$_3$Bi$_5$, which exhibits superconductivity without an accompanying charge density wave, provides an ideal platform to investigate the intrinsic electronic structure and superconductivity. Moreover, it enables the exploration of superconductivity in the two-dimensional limit of the kagome lattice. Here, we systematically investigate the influence of biaxial mechanical strain ($\varepsilon$) on the electronic structure and superconductivity of monolayer CsTi$_3$Bi$_5$ using first-principles calculations. We demonstrate that the prominent van Hove singularity (VHS) at the M point can be monotonically tuned to the Fermi level by tensile strain. Furthermore, the superconducting transition temperature $T_C$ exhibits a dome-shaped dependence on strain, reaching a maximum of 3.6 K at an optimal tensile strain of $\varepsilon=+2\%$. The average superconducting gap magnitude is 0.35 meV, with an orbital-dependent and anisotropic distribution. Our results provide a detailed understanding of the superconductivity of monolayer CsTi$_3$Bi$_5$ and show that strain is an effective, continuous tuning knob for manipulating the electronic structure and superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文用第一性原理计算研究双轴机械应变对单层 CsTi3Bi5 电子结构和超导电性的调控，发现拉伸应变可连续调节 M 点范霍夫奇异性至费米能级，并在 +2% 应变下使 Tc 达到最高 3.6 K。
AI.motivation: CsTi3Bi5 是无电荷密度波伴随的超导钛基笼目金属，可作为研究本征电子结构和二维笼目超导的理想平台；同时需要探索应变作为连续调控手段对其电子结构和超导性的影响。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算系统研究双轴机械应变 ε 对单层 CsTi3Bi5 电子结构和超导电性的影响，并分析范霍夫奇异性、超导转变温度 Tc 及超导能隙随应变的变化。
AI.result: 拉伸应变可将 M 点显著范霍夫奇异性单调调节至费米能级；Tc 随应变呈穹顶形依赖，在最优拉伸应变 ε=+2% 时达到最大值 3.6 K；平均超导能隙为 0.35 meV，且具有轨道依赖和各向异性分布。
AI.conclusion: 研究深入理解了单层 CsTi3Bi5 的超导电性，并表明机械应变是操控其电子结构和超导电性的有效且连续的调节旋钮。

title: Tensor Networks for Materials Simulation and Quantum Chemistry
summary: Predicting the properties of correlated materials and molecules often requires a many-body description that goes beyond single-particle and mean-field approximations. Tensor networks address this challenge by exploiting the entanglement structure of quantum states to construct compact, systematically improvable representations. Although developed largely for idealized model Hamiltonians, these methods are increasingly being integrated into material-specific calculations. This Perspective introduces their underlying principles and examines how network geometry, bond-dimension truncation, and approximate contraction determine the accuracy and computational reach of these approaches. We survey applications across regimes of increasing complexity, ranging from ground-state properties of quantum magnets and itinerant-fermion systems to excitation spectra, nonequilibrium dynamics, finite-temperature and open systems, and molecular electronic structure. We then examine four routes connecting these methods to real materials, including experimentally constrained models, downfolded Hamiltonians, dynamical mean-field theory with tensor network impurity solvers, and quantum embedding. Throughout, we evaluate the maturity of existing capabilities and their principal limitations, synthesizing this assessment into a practical method-selection guide. We argue that reliable materials predictions require quantifying uncertainties introduced at each stage, from constructing material-specific Hamiltonians to extracting experimentally accessible observables. Finally, we identify the algorithmic advances and reproducible computational practices needed to establish tensor networks as a routine tool for predictive materials science and quantum chemistry.

AI.tldr: 该文是一篇 Perspective，系统评述张量网络方法在关联材料与分子多体问题中的应用前景、精度来源、与真实材料连接的路径及成熟度，并提出方法选择与不确定性量化建议。
AI.motivation: 关联材料和分子性质常需超越单粒子和平均场近似的多体描述；张量网络可利用量子态纠缠结构实现紧凑且可系统改进的表示，但此前多用于理想模型，亟需评估其材料特异性计算中的能力与局限。
AI.method: 介绍张量网络基本原理，分析网络几何、键维截断和近似收缩对精度与计算范围的影响；综述从量子磁体、巡游费米子基态到激发谱、非平衡动力学、有限温度/开放系统和分子电子结构的应用；讨论实验约束模型、下折叠哈密顿量、张量网络杂质求解器辅助的DMFT以及量子嵌入四条连接真实材料的路线。
AI.result: 文章评估了现有能力的成熟度和主要限制，综合形成实用的方法选择指南；强调可靠材料预测需量化从构建材料特异性哈密顿量到提取实验可观测量的各阶段不确定性，并指出所需算法进展和可复现计算实践。
AI.conclusion: 张量网络有望成为预测材料科学与量子化学的常规工具，但其可靠性取决于对近似误差和不确定性的系统量化，以及算法发展和可复现计算规范的建立。

title: Majorana Edge-to-bound State Transition in Interferometric Superconductor Rings
summary: Manipulating flux quanta in topological superconductors is central to vortex braiding in quantum computing. Their interferometric superconducting rings can host either topologically protected edge states with fluxes confined inside the central hollow area or vortex bound states in flux cores at the annulus walls. Here we demonstrate a strategy to drive topological edge states into vortex bound states by tuning the relative scale of vortex size and annulus width in nano-ring interferometric device on 2M-WS$_2$ topological superconductor. Near its superconducting transition where the coherence length exceeds the annulus width, Little-Parks oscillations exhibit expected periods for flux bundles in ring-center, consistent with edge states residing at inner and outer rims of the annulus. Upon cooling, where the coherence length shrinks below the annulus width, the unexpectedly increased oscillation period reflects multiple fluxes distributed along annulus region in flux necklace configuration, implying a transition from extended edge states to localized vortex bound states. Ginzburg-Landau simulations and local density-of-states calculations with Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations reveal that large values for both Ginzburg-Landau parameter and flux-pinning energy are vital for such a transition. Our findings provide a novel strategy for understanding flux manipulation towards flux braiding and topological quantum computing.

AI.tldr: 该文在2M-WS₂拓扑超导纳米环干涉器件中，通过调节涡旋尺寸与环宽相对比例，实现拓扑边缘态向涡旋束缚态的转变，并揭示其物理条件。
AI.motivation: 操控拓扑超导体中的磁通量子对涡旋编织和拓扑量子计算至关重要；纳米环干涉器可承载拓扑边缘态或涡旋核束缚态，但如何可控驱动二者转变尚需研究。
AI.method: 制备2M-WS₂拓扑超导纳米环干涉器件，测量Little-Parks振荡随温度/相干长度的变化；结合Ginzburg-Landau模拟和Bogoliubov-de Gennes方程局域态密度计算分析涡旋构型与转变机制。
AI.result: 近超导转变时相干长度大于环宽，Little-Parks振荡周期符合环心磁通束，边缘态位于环内外缘；降温后相干长度小于环宽，振荡周期异常增大，表明磁通以“磁通项链”形式沿环区分布，发生从扩展边缘态到局域涡旋束缚态的转变。模拟显示大的Ginzburg-Landau参数和磁通钉扎能是该转变的关键。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出通过调控涡旋尺寸与环宽相对尺度来操纵磁通和拓扑态的新策略，为磁通编织及拓扑量子计算提供基础。

title: Unconventional charge density wave order in ErTe$_{3}$: symmetry breakings and fluctuations probed by Raman scattering
summary: Recent experiments have revealed unexpected mirror-symmetry breakings in the charge density-wave (CDW) state of rare-earth tritellurides, suggesting a putative ferro-axial CDW state. Here we report polarization-resolved Raman scattering measurements tracking the point-group symmetry breakings across the CDW phase transition in the rare-earth tritelluride ErTe$_3$. We show that the mirror-symmetry breakings follow closely the emergence of the CDW order, suggesting a single component CDW order parameter. Furthermore, Raman measurements in the $A_{2g}$ symmetry channel above the CDW transition temperature indicate the absence of significant ferro-axial fluctuations. We discuss the broad implications of these findings with respect to the nature of the CDW state in the tritellurides.

AI.tldr: 本文用偏振分辨拉曼散射追踪 ErTe3 中 CDW 相变前后的点群对称性破缺，发现镜面对称破缺与 CDW 序参量出现紧密同步，且转变温度以上 A2g 通道无显著铁轴涨落，支持单分量 CDW 序参量并限制铁轴 CDW 图像。
AI.motivation: 近期实验在稀土三碲化物的电荷密度波态中发现意外的镜面对称破缺，提示可能存在“铁轴”CDW 态；作者希望直接检验该对称性破缺与 CDW 序参量的关系及其涨落特征。
AI.method: 对 ErTe3 进行偏振分辨拉曼散射测量，跟踪 CDW 相变前后的点群对称性破缺；并在 CDW 转变温度以上测量 A2g 对称通道，以探测铁轴涨落。
AI.result: 镜面对称破缺随 CDW 序的出现而紧密发生，表明 CDW 序参量可能为单分量；转变温度以上 A2g 通道未显示显著铁轴涨落。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持 ErTe3 中 CDW 具有单分量序参量，并对稀土三碲化物中 CDW 态的本质及铁轴 CDW 解释给出重要约束。

title: Zeeman Shift and Injection Currents under Light Irradiation
summary: The conversion of light into electrical currents enables energy harvesting and photodetection. Conventional second-order dc photocurrents are driven by the electric component of light through electric-dipole coupling and require broken inversion symmetry. Here, we show that the electric and magnetic components of light jointly generate Zeeman shift and injection currents. Using quantum perturbation theory, we derive explicit microscopic expressions for their conductivity tensors. We systematically classify the symmetry constraints on these responses and show how they differ from those governing conventional photocurrents. In particular, both responses can occur in centrosymmetric systems with spin-orbit coupling or noncollinear magnetic order, irrespective of time-reversal symmetry. A centrosymmetric kagome model exhibits broadband responses. First-principles calculations for Mn$_3$Sn further predict Zeeman injection and shift current densities of $10^{2}$-$10^{3}~\mathrm{A/m^{2}}$ and $1$-$10~\mathrm{A/m^{2}}$, respectively, under illumination with an electric-field amplitude $E=10^{4}~\mathrm{V/m}$. These magnitudes place both currents within experimental reach.

AI.tldr: 该文提出光的电场与磁场分量共同驱动的塞曼位移电流和塞曼注入电流，并给出微观理论、对称性分类及材料预测。
AI.motivation: 传统二阶直流光电流主要由光的电场通过电偶极耦合驱动，且通常要求反演对称破缺；作者希望探索电场与磁场共同参与、可在更广泛对称性材料中产生的新型非线性光电流。
AI.method: 使用量子微扰理论推导塞曼位移电流和塞曼注入电流的电导率张量微观表达式，系统分类其对称性约束，并用中心对称kagome模型与Mn3Sn第一性原理计算验证。
AI.result: 两类电流可在具有自旋轨道耦合或非共线磁序的中心对称体系中产生，且不依赖时间反演对称性；中心对称kagome模型显示宽带响应；Mn3Sn在E=10^4 V/m光照下预测塞曼注入电流密度为10^2-10^3 A/m^2，塞曼位移电流密度为1-10 A/m^2。
AI.conclusion: 电场与磁场联合驱动的非线性光电流突破了传统电偶极光电流对反演对称破缺的要求，且在中心对称和磁性材料中可达实验可测水平。

title: Electronic structure of a persistent excitonic fluid far beyond the Mott limit
summary: Excitons are conventionally expected to destabilize at high photoexcitation densities, as screening weakens the electron-hole attraction. Recent studies, however, challenge this paradigm, suggesting that excitons generated by strong optical pumping can remain stable even beyond the onset of population inversion. Here, using time- and angle-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy on 2D hybrid perovskites, we provide direct evidence for such a high-density excitonic state, characterized by a distinctive Mexican-hat dispersion. Remarkably, this excitonic band reconstruction endures for orders of magnitude longer than the optical coherence time, revealing a population-sustained electronic structure that survives well into the incoherent regime. The excitonic resonance also persists far beyond optical saturation, at densities where exciton wavefunctions strongly overlap. Our findings reveal a long-lived, high-density quantum fluid of excitons with characteristics reminiscent of a BCS condensate, an electronic structure markedly different from that of the dilute limit.

AI.tldr: 利用时间分辨与角分辨光电子能谱，在二维杂化钙钛矿中观测到高密度下仍稳定的激子态，并具有墨西哥帽色散和远超光学相干时间的寿命。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为高光激发密度下屏蔽效应会削弱电子-空穴吸引并使激子失稳；近期研究则提示强光泵浦产生的激子甚至可在粒子数反转后保持稳定，本文旨在直接检验这一高密度激子态。
AI.method: 对二维杂化钙钛矿开展时间分辨与角分辨光电子能谱（TrARPES）测量，追踪光激发后的能带色散与激子共振随时间和密度的演化。
AI.result: 直接观测到高密度激子态形成的墨西哥帽色散；该激子能带重构的持续时间比光学相干时间长数个量级，并可延续到非相干区；激子共振在超过光学饱和、激子波函数强烈重叠的密度下仍存在。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明存在长寿命的高密度激子量子流体，其电子结构类似BCS凝聚体，显著不同于稀薄极限下的激子图像，挑战了高密度下激子必然失稳的传统范式。

title: Lattice Symmetry Remnants in Spatial and Temporal Entanglement of Quantum Critical Spin Chains
summary: Quantum critical lattice models carry universal information beyond the bulk data of their infrared conformal field theory (CFT): microscopic lattice symmetries constrain how the CFT is realized. We probe these remnants through the spatial and temporal entanglement of two Euclidean-evolved states from the same critical model. In the finite-length scaling regime, a conformal boundary encodes the long-distance effect of the short-range initial state, and boundary CFT (BCFT) organizes the universal low-lying entanglement spectrum. We formulate the temporal state as a uniform infinite matrix product state evolved by a symmetry-preserving infinite matrix product operator, using a local factorization regular even at arbitrarily small Trotter steps. For the Ising and three-state Potts chains, whose relevant symmetries are onsite, the spatial and temporal constructions approach the same BCFT structure; varying the initial state engineers conformal boundaries distinguishable spectroscopically. The spin-1/2 XXZ chain instead realizes a Lieb--Schultz--Mattis (LSM) constraint between internal U(1) symmetry and one-site translation. A U(1)-preserving short-range spatial state accommodates it through a doubled unit cell and inequivalent entanglement cuts, whereas the temporal state remains uniform along Euclidean time. Successive spatial transfer steps pump the temporal entanglement spectrum between translation-related Dirichlet sectors, equivalently between integer and half-integer compact-boson zero modes. Breaking U(1) removes both the zero mode and the alternation. Continued evolution at fixed bond dimension crosses over from the finite-length BCFT regime to a finite-entanglement regime generated by symmetry-allowed relevant deformations. Thus microscopic symmetry and anomaly data remain visible in universal entanglement by constraining the boundary realization of the infrared CFT.

AI.tldr: 该文通过同一临界晶格模型的两个欧氏演化态的空间与时间纠缠，研究微观晶格对称性如何约束红外 CFT 的边界实现，并用 BCFT 组织低能纠缠谱。
AI.motivation: 量子临界晶格模型除红外 CFT 体数据外还携带普适信息：微观晶格对称性会限制 CFT 的实现方式。作者希望从纠缠中直接探测这些“残留”信息。
AI.method: 将时间态表述为受对称性保持的无限矩阵乘积算符演化的均匀无限矩阵乘积态，并采用对任意小 Trotter 步仍正则的局部分解；对 Ising、三态 Potts 和 spin-1/2 XXZ 链比较空间/时间构造、纠缠谱及边界条件。
AI.result: Ising 与三态 Potts 链的 onsite 对称性使空间和时间构造趋于同一 BCFT 结构，改变初态可工程化光谱可区分的共形边界；XXZ 链体现 U(1) 内部对称性与单格点平移间的 LSM 约束，空间态通过双胞和不等价纠缠切适配，而时间态沿欧氏时间保持均匀，空间转移步在平移相关的 Dirichlet 扇区（等价于整数/半整数紧致玻色零模）间泵浦时间纠缠谱；破坏 U(1) 会消除零模和交替。固定键维继续演化会从有限长度 BCFT 区过渡到由对称性允许的相关变形产生的有限纠缠区。
AI.conclusion: 微观对称性与反常数据通过约束红外 CFT 的边界实现，仍可在普适纠缠中显现。

title: Kinetic competition controls loss-induced exceptional points of Hubbard pairs
summary: Two-body loss can bind two fermions in a Hubbard lattice, yet the binding threshold in the infinite lattice need not be an exceptional point (EP). At fixed total momentum $\mathbf{K}$, the hops of the two particles interfere into a relative-motion hopping along each lattice direction, which sets the kinetic energy of the relative motion. On a hypercubic lattice, the threshold $g_c=1/[\pi\rho_2(0)]$ is an EP precisely when the maximum kinetic energy along one direction exceeds the sum of the transverse maxima. This dominance keeps every transverse-momentum scattering channel propagating near the band center, making the local pair Green function purely imaginary there. Two real-energy scattering zeros associated with coherent perfect absorption then coalesce at the threshold into a second-order EP of the analytically continued pair problem, where loss restores the parity-time symmetry of the pair's scattering solutions. Without a dominant direction, binding occurs without coalescence and without breaking of that symmetry. Total momentum can therefore select EP sectors even on isotropic lattices. More broadly, the kinetic structure of the two-particle continuum determines whether loss-induced binding and exceptional degeneracy coincide.

AI.tldr: 该文指出，Hubbard晶格中两体损失导致的费米子束缚阈值不一定是例外点；是否存在EP由固定总动量下两粒子连续谱的动力学结构决定。
AI.motivation: 澄清损失诱导的两费米子束缚与例外简并是否必然同时发生，并理解无限晶格中束缚阈值与EP的关系。
AI.method: 在固定总动量K下，将两粒子跃迁干涉为沿各晶格方向的相对运动跃迁，以相对运动动能和横向动量散射通道分析局域对格林函数、散射零点及解析延拓后的配对问题。
AI.result: 在超立方晶格上，阈值g_c=1/[πρ2(0)]恰为EP的条件是某一方向的最大动能超过横向最大值之和；该主导方向使横向动量散射通道在带中心附近均传播，使局域对格林函数在此纯虚，并使与相干完美吸收相关的两个实能散射零点在阈值处合并为二阶EP，损失恢复配对散射解的PT对称。若无主导方向，则发生束缚但无零点合并且不破缺该对称性。
AI.conclusion: 总动量可在各向同性晶格上选择EP扇区；更一般地，两粒子连续谱的动能结构决定损失诱导束缚与例外简并是否重合。

title: Low-Temperature Hybrid Monte Carlo for Perylene and Corannulene: Stabilizing Determinant and Force
summary: We demonstrate a real world physics study of the molecules perylene and corannulene at different doping levels, and calculating selected one-, two- (exciton) and three-body (trion) correlators. This has been done by performing Hubbard-model simulations near room temperature. We find, between charge neutral and doubly charged plateaus of perylene, an interaction-induced $\Delta Q = 1$ plateau whose width grows with interaction strength and in which the ground state is a spin doublet rather than a singlet. The algorithmic advancement enabling this study simultaneously stabilizes the determinant and force calculations to machine precision at room temperature, while scaling as well as standard determinant Quantum Monte Carlo simulations of these systems. Furthermore, our formalism retains the full time-displaced (2-point) Green's function, allowing us to construct any $n$-body correlator, including those that contain disconnected diagrams.

AI.tldr: 该工作用近室温 Hubbard 模型模拟研究苝和碗烯在不同掺杂下的多体关联，发现苝在电荷中性到双电荷平台之间存在相互作用诱导的 ΔQ=1 平台，其基态为自旋双重态，并提出了稳定行列式与力计算、可计算任意 n 体关联函数（含非连通图）的算法。
AI.motivation: 分子体系中的电子关联、激子与三体（trion）等多体效应需要可靠且可扩展到有限温度的数值方法；现有行列式量子蒙特卡洛在近室温下常面临数值不稳定，且需同时获得高阶关联函数。
AI.method: 对苝和碗烯在不同掺杂水平下进行近室温 Hubbard 模型模拟，计算选定的一体、二体（激子）和三体（trion）关联函数；算法上改进行列式与力计算，使其在室温下稳定到机器精度，并保持与标准行列式量子蒙特卡洛相当的标度；形式体系保留完整的时间位移两点格林函数，从而可构造任意 n 体关联函数，包括含非连通图的关联函数。
AI.result: 在苝的电荷中性平台与双电荷平台之间发现相互作用诱导的 ΔQ=1 平台，其宽度随相互作用强度增大，且该平台基态为自旋双重态而非单重态；同时获得了不同掺杂下苝和碗烯的一体、二体与三体关联信息。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了近室温下可稳定、可扩展地计算分子体系高阶多体关联的 Hubbard 模拟框架，并揭示了相互作用诱导的新电荷平台与自旋态，为理解分子量子材料中的关联效应提供了工具和物理洞见。

title: Hybrid Monte Carlo for the extended Kane-Mele-Hubbard model
summary: The Hubbard model offers a powerful minimal description of strongly correlated electrons in molecules and materials, yet it neglects effects observed in nature that give rise to a much richer variety of physics. For instance, including nonlocal interactions introduces a competition between strongly correlated phases, while incorporating spin-orbit coupling (SOC) can lead to the emergence of exotic topological phases. Seeking a more realistic platform for simulating graphene and, potentially, related materials such as transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), we therefore consider the extended Kane-Mele-Hubbard model, which features a Kane-Mele SOC term and nearest-neighbor interactions. Simulating this model is particularly challenging once the nonlocal interactions become dominant over the on-site Hubbard interaction, as a severe sign problem arises already at half filling, leaving this regime largely unexplored. In this work, we develop continuous auxiliary field formulations of the model, suitable for treatment with the Hybrid Monte Carlo (HMC) algorithm. Using these formulations, we characterize the sign problem across the model's parameter space and establish where simulations are feasible, as a first step toward the full phase diagram.

AI.tldr: 该文为扩展Kane-Mele-Hubbard模型开发连续辅助场HMC方法，系统表征符号问题并确定可模拟的参数区域。
AI.motivation: 标准Hubbard模型忽略非局域相互作用和自旋轨道耦合等效应；为更真实模拟石墨烯及TMD等材料，需要研究含Kane-Mele SOC和最近邻相互作用的扩展模型。
AI.method: 构建适用于Hybrid Monte Carlo的连续辅助场表述，并在模型参数空间中扫描和刻画符号问题。
AI.result: 识别了非局域相互作用主导、半填充下符号问题严重且此前少被探索的区域，并给出模拟可行性的参数范围。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为后续完整相图研究奠定基础，明确了扩展Kane-Mele-Hubbard模型可进行HMC模拟的区域。

title: Discrete WKB approach to density profiles in inhomogeneous two-band free-fermion chains
summary: We extend the discrete WKB method to one-dimensional bipartite tight-binding chains of free fermions with slowly varying hopping amplitudes and on-site potentials. We focus on the inhomogeneous Rice-Mele model, suggesting possible experimental realizations thereof in optical superlattices. We derive explicit semiclassical expressions for the single-particle wave functions and density of states, as well as the sublattice-resolved local particle densities and filling fraction at arbitrary Fermi energy. In particular, we show that the WKB density profiles agree with those obtained from the local-density approximation. We analyze the spatial dependence of the local band edges and its consequences for the global spectral structure, and clarify the role played by the phase-space topology in determining the Bohr-Sommerfeld quantization conditions. Finally, we illustrate our results with two representative examples: a homogeneous Rice-Mele chain subject to a harmonic trap and a fully inhomogeneous chain containing a domain wall.

AI.tldr: 本文将离散 WKB 方法推广到具有缓变跃迁振幅和格点势的一维二分紧束缚自由费米子链，重点研究非均匀 Rice-Mele 模型并给出半经典解析结果与示例。
AI.motivation: 非均匀二分紧束缚链（如 Rice-Mele 模型）在光学超晶格等体系中可实现，但缺乏系统的半经典描述；需要理解缓变参数下波函数、态密度、子晶格分辨密度及谱结构。
AI.method: 将离散 WKB 方法应用于一维二分紧束缚链，推导单粒子波函数和态密度的显式半经典表达式，以及任意费米能下的子晶格分辨局域粒子密度和填充率；比较 WKB 密度分布与局域密度近似（LDA），分析局域带边空间依赖对全局谱结构的影响，并厘清相空间拓扑对 Bohr-Sommerfeld 量子化条件的作用。
AI.result: 得到与 LDA 一致的 WKB 密度分布；揭示局域带边的空间变化如何决定全局谱结构；明确相空间拓扑在 Bohr-Sommerfeld 量子化条件中的角色；并以受谐波势的均匀 Rice-Mele 链和含畴壁的完全非均匀链为例展示结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把离散 WKB 方法扩展到非均匀二分紧束缚自由费米子链，为 Rice-Mele 模型及光学超晶格实现提供半经典理论框架，并强调相空间拓扑对量子化条件的重要性。

title: Interplay of Chemical Disorder, Vortex Pinning, and Electron Correlations in the Mechanically Robust Medium-Entropy Alloy Superconductor $\text{Nb}_{0.45}\text{Ta}_{0.25}\text{Ti}_{0.15}\text{Hf}_{0.15}$
summary: Medium and high-entropy alloys have emerged as a promising class of superconducting materials because their intrinsic chemical disorder can simultaneously enhance mechanical robustness and modify superconducting properties. Here, we present a combined experimental and first-principles investigation of the structural, superconducting, electronic, and local lattice-distortion characteristics of the mechanically robust medium-entropy alloy $\text{Nb}_{0.45}\text{Ta}_{0.25}\text{Ti}_{0.15}\text{Hf}_{0.15}$. The material shows type-II superconductivity with a transition temperature $T_C^{onset} \approx 7.8 ~\mathrm{K}$. A high critical current density of $J_c = 0.48 \times 10^{6}~\mathrm{A/cm^2}$ is observed, and this is attributed to strong vortex pinning at grain boundaries. Specific-heat analysis indicates a strong electron-phonon coupling ($\lambda$ = 1.07) with a large isotropic s-wave superconducting gap. Density functional theory calculations explicitly model the intrinsic chemical disorder, predict a stable body-centered cubic phase. These calculations further reveal a metallic electronic structure with substantial Ti- and Ta-derived states at the Fermi level. Additionally, our results quantify a pronounced disorder-induced local lattice distortion ($\Delta d = 0.086$ A), providing a microscopic basis for the experimentally observed enhanced vortex-pinning landscape. Remarkably, the alloy also exhibits an unusually large Kadowaki-Woods ratio, placing it close to the heavy-fermion regime and indicating enhanced electronic correlations beyond conventional alloy superconductors. Our results demonstrate that entropy-engineered chemical disorder can stabilize robust superconductivity, promote strong flux pinning, and induce correlated electronic behavior, establishing refractory medium-entropy alloys as a promising platform for next-generation superconducting materials.

AI.tldr: 该文结合实验与第一性原理研究了难熔中熵合金Nb0.45Ta0.25Ti0.15Hf0.15的结构、超导性、电子性质及局域晶格畸变，发现其具有稳健的II型超导、强涡旋钉扎和增强电子关联。
AI.motivation: 中/高熵合金的固有化学无序有望同时提升力学稳健性并调控超导性质，因此需要研究难熔中熵合金作为新型超导材料平台的潜力。
AI.method: 采用实验与密度泛函理论相结合的方法，表征Nb0.45Ta0.25Ti0.15Hf0.15的结构、超导转变、临界电流密度、比热及电子结构，并在DFT中显式建模化学无序和局域晶格畸变。
AI.result: 该合金为II型超导体，Tc^onset约7.8 K，Jc达0.48×10^6 A/cm^2，归因于晶界强涡旋钉扎；比热分析给出强电子-声子耦合λ=1.07和大的各向同性s波超导能隙；DFT预测稳定的BCC相、金属性电子结构及费米能级处显著的Ti/Ta贡献；并量化出明显无序诱导局域晶格畸变Δd=0.086 Å，且具有异常大的Kadowaki-Woods比，接近重费米子区域。
AI.conclusion: 熵工程诱导的化学无序可稳定稳健超导性、促进强磁通钉扎并引发关联电子行为，表明难熔中熵合金是下一代超导材料的有前景平台。

title: Effect of oxygen plasma treatment on the structural and superconducting properties of atomic-layer-deposited NbN thin films
summary: Surface oxidation is a common concern for ultrathin NbN superconducting devices, yet which superconducting properties it affects has not been established for films grown by plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition. We expose NbN films about 11.4 nm thick to an O$_2$ plasma for 0 to 60 s, which oxidizes the surface without etching the film, and characterize the same sample series by X-ray diffraction, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), and transport measurements on 500 nm wide nanowires. XPS of the surface and the underlying layer shows that the plasma converts the surface to Nb$_2$O$_5$, whereas the bulk of the treated film is chemically identical to that of the untreated film. Crystalline $\delta$-NbN remains intact. During exposure, the total film thickness rises and saturates between 40 and 60 s, indicating self-limiting surface oxide growth. The normal-state resistivity rises by 21% (dc) and 25% (optical) with the plasma dose, while the critical temperature and transition width are unchanged. The switching current densities of 4.9-6.2 MA/cm$^2$ at 4.2 K show no systematic dependence on the plasma dose. Their temperature dependence follows the dirty-limit depairing current of Kupriyanov and Lukichev, and the extrapolated switching currents reach 39-46% of the depairing current calculated from the optical resistivity and diffusion coefficient, in agreement with the width dependence reported for nanowires from the same process. The oxygen signature is confined to temperatures near $T_c$, where the supercurrent of the treated wires vanishes at least 0.5 K earlier than that of the untreated wire, consistent with a partially oxidized surface layer that acts on the film by the proximity effect. At these doses, oxygen narrows the temperature range of the supercurrent from above but does not systematically reduce the low-temperature current-carrying capacity of the wires.

AI.tldr: O$_2$等离子体对约11.4 nm厚PEALD NbN薄膜进行0–60 s表面氧化，形成自限制Nb$_2$O$_5$表层而不破坏体相δ-NbN；正常态电阻率升高，但T$_c$、转变宽度及4.2 K开关电流密度基本不变，氧主要使超电流在接近T$_c$处提前消失。
AI.motivation: 超薄NbN超导器件普遍担心表面氧化，但对等离子体增强原子层沉积（PEALD）生长的NbN薄膜，表面氧化究竟影响哪些超导性质尚无定论。
AI.method: 将约11.4 nm厚NbN薄膜暴露于O$_2$等离子体0–60 s，在不刻蚀薄膜的情况下氧化表面；对同一系列样品进行XRD、XPS和500 nm宽纳米线的输运测量。
AI.result: XPS显示表面转化为Nb$_2$O$_5$，体相化学组成与未处理膜相同，晶体δ-NbN保持完整；膜厚增加并在40–60 s饱和，表明表面氧化物自限制生长。正常态电阻率随剂量升高21%（dc）和25%（光学），但T$_c$和转变宽度不变。4.2 K下开关电流密度为4.9–6.2 MA/cm$^2$，无系统性剂量依赖；其温度依赖符合Kupriyanov–Lukichev脏极限脱配对电流，外推开关电流为光学电阻率和扩散系数计算脱配对电流的39–46%。氧的信号主要局限于T$_c$附近，处理线超电流比未处理线至少提前0.5 K消失，符合部分氧化表层通过近邻效应作用于薄膜。
AI.conclusion: 在该剂量范围内，氧从高温侧收窄超电流温区，但不会系统性降低纳米线低温载流能力；表面氧化主要形成自限制Nb$_2$O$_5$表层并影响近T$_c$行为。

title: Zero photoemission from icosahedral superatoms
summary: Photoemission is expected to occur when the photon energy exceeds the binding energy of an electron, with the photoemission yield generally remaining non-zero above this threshold. Yet, it can be suppressed at specific photon energies, a phenomenon known as the Cooper minimum. Although complete suppression represents an extreme limit of this phenomenon, such zero photoemission has previously been reported only for atoms with an outermost s-type orbital and has never been observed in non-atomic systems. Here, we demonstrate the deliberate realization of zero photoemission from Ag12W-, an artificial icosahedral superatom, by observing a vanishing photoemission cross section 0.85 eV above the detachment threshold and reproducing this behavior in theoretical simulations. These simulations predict that zero photoemission can be common in nearly spherical nanoclusters, a prediction we experimentally confirm using Ag12Mo-, an isoelectronic counterpart of Ag12W-. Because superatoms offer systematic control over both size and elemental composition using the periodic table, our findings establish a route toward active control of photoemission in finite-size quantum systems and stimulate further investigations of underexplored physical phenomena such as nondipole effects.

AI.tldr: 在人工二十面体超原子Ag12W-中，于脱附阈值以上0.85 eV处观测到光电离截面消失，即零光电发射；理论模拟再现该现象并预测其在近球形纳米团簇中普遍存在，并用等电子对应物Ag12Mo-实验验证。
AI.motivation: 光电离通常发生在光子能量超过电子结合能时，但特定光子能量可抑制光电发射（Cooper minimum）；完全抑制此前仅在外层s轨道原子中报道，尚未在非原子体系中观测。作者希望探索并主动控制有限尺寸量子体系中的光电发射。
AI.method: 以Ag12W-人工二十面体超原子为对象，测量其光电离截面随光子能量的变化，观测到脱附阈值以上0.85 eV处截面消失，并结合理论模拟复现该行为；进一步用等电子对应物Ag12Mo-进行实验验证，并预测近球形纳米团簇中的普遍性。
AI.result: Ag12W-在脱附阈值以上0.85 eV处表现出零光电发射，理论模拟与实验一致；模拟预测零光电发射在近球形纳米团簇中可能普遍存在，并由Ag12Mo-的实验结果确认。
AI.conclusion: 超原子可利用元素周期表系统调控尺寸和元素组成，因此该工作为有限尺寸量子体系中光电发射的主动控制提供了途径，并将推动非偶极效应等尚未充分探索的物理现象研究。

title: PULSES: multi-agent AI for autonomous excited-state model building and dynamics
summary: Simulating molecular excited-state processes requires resolving electronic and nuclear dynamics, but the cost of direct quantum-chemical calculations limits accessible system sizes and timescales. Machine-learning models can extend these simulations, yet they often need to be tailored to specific molecular systems and scientific objectives. Building and deploying such models requires coordinated decisions across conformational sampling, quantum-chemical labelling, model training, validation and dynamics. Here we introduce Paired agents for Unified Learning and Simulation of Excited States (PULSES), a multi-agent system that automates this workflow within expert-approved boundaries. A human expert and planner define the scientific objective, methods and decision boundaries, while an orchestrator coordinates domain agents and artifact-specific scientific assurance during execution. We evaluate PULSES on 15 computational chemistry tasks and demonstrate end-to-end applications to perylene exciton Hamiltonians, solvent-dependent biphenyl relaxation, and excited-state proton transfer in 10-hydroxybenzo[h]quinoline. These results demonstrate traceable, expert-bounded construction and deployment of specialized excited-state models, while retaining scientific validation as a requirement rather than assuming that successful execution establishes correctness.

AI.tldr: PULSES 是一个多智能体系统，可在专家设定边界内自动完成激发态机器学习模型的构建、验证与动力学模拟全流程。
AI.motivation: 直接量子化学计算成本高，限制激发态分子过程模拟的系统尺寸和时间尺度；现有机器学习模型常需针对特定体系和目标定制，且涉及构象采样、量化标注、训练、验证与动力学等多环节协同决策。
AI.method: 提出 Paired agents for Unified Learning and Simulation of Excited States（PULSES）。人类专家与规划器定义科学目标、方法和决策边界，编排器协调领域智能体，并在执行中对具体产物进行科学保障；自动化构象采样、量子化学标注、模型训练、验证和动力学部署。
AI.result: 在15个计算化学任务上评估，并端到端应用于苝激子哈密顿量、溶剂依赖的联苯弛豫以及10-羟基苯并[h]喹啉的激发态质子转移。
AI.conclusion: PULSES 支持可追溯、专家受限地构建和部署专用激发态模型，同时强调科学验证是必要条件，而非假定成功执行即代表正确性。

title: Quantifying the effect of heavy-atom only augmented basis sets for the calculation of non-covalent interactions
summary: Truncating the basis set is a straightforward way of reducing the computational cost of a calculation, often done by augmenting only the non-hydrogen atoms with diffuse functions. Calculations of non-covalent interactions, which require large diffuse basis sets for quantitative results, regularly employ this truncation. Herein, we assess the validity of this basis set truncation across the A24 and S66 datasets and for case study examples at a range of interaction distances. For the majority of non-covalent interactions, we find that the heavy-atom-only augmented basis sets can be safely applied as a method of reducing computational cost. However, for aliphatic-aliphatic and $\pi$-aliphatic type dispersion interactions, we find that lower cardinal number basis sets with full augmentation for all atoms, including hydrogen, can provide similar or even more accurate results than higher cardinal number basis sets with partial augmentation. These results emphasize that increasing basis set size and computational cost does not necessarily improve accuracy; rather, the composition of a basis set is critical to achieving highly accurate and efficient computations.

AI.tldr: 评估仅对重原子加弥散函数的基组截断在非共价相互作用计算中的有效性；多数体系可安全使用，但脂肪-脂肪和π-脂肪色散相互作用例外。
AI.motivation: 通过截断基组（常仅对非氢原子加弥散函数）可降低计算成本，但其在需要大弥散基组的非共价相互作用计算中的有效性尚需系统验证。
AI.method: 在A24和S66数据集及不同相互作用距离的案例中，比较仅重原子加弥散与全原子（含氢）加弥散基组的表现。
AI.result: 多数非共价相互作用中，仅重原子加弥散可安全降低计算成本；但对于脂肪-脂肪和π-脂肪型色散相互作用，低基数全原子加弥散基组可给出与高基数部分加弥散基组相当甚至更准确的结果。
AI.conclusion: 基组尺寸和计算成本的增加不一定提高精度；基组组成对实现高精度且高效的计算至关重要，需针对相互作用类型谨慎选择弥散函数加设策略。

title: Low-variance force estimators for nuclear quantum mean forces
summary: Quantum equilibrium structure can be sampled using classical molecular dynamics with a learned effective potential for a single path-integral replica, but the primitive mean-force estimates obtained from path-integral molecular dynamics with that replica held fixed are noisy. We derive a scaled-gradient estimator with zero sampling variance for a one-dimensional harmonic oscillator and an estimated 4.7--57.5-fold reduction in constrained-sampling time for the molecular tests. The resulting potentials can be trained on these forces like standard machine-learning interatomic potentials and yield stable production simulations from which quantum expectation values of position-dependent observables are obtained as classical ensemble averages.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一种缩放梯度估计器，用于降低固定单一路径积分副本时PIMD均值力估计的噪声，从而训练出可用于经典MD采样的有效势，并以经典系综平均获得量子期望值。
AI.motivation: 利用学习到的有效势对单个路径积分副本做经典分子动力学可采样量子平衡结构，但固定该副本时由路径积分分子动力学得到的原始均值力估计噪声较大，限制有效势训练与稳定模拟。
AI.method: 推导缩放梯度估计器以替代原始均值力估计；在简谐振子中解析证明其采样方差为零，并在分子体系中用约束采样估计时间缩减；将所得力用于类似标准机器学习原子间势的训练，进而在有效势上运行稳定生产模拟。
AI.result: 一维简谐振子中缩放梯度估计器具有零采样方差；分子测试中约束采样时间估计减少4.7–57.5倍；训练所得有效势可支持稳定生产模拟，并将位置依赖可观测量的量子期望值表示为经典系综平均。
AI.conclusion: 缩放梯度估计器显著降低均值力采样噪声与约束采样成本，使基于单副本有效势的经典MD能够高效、稳定地采样量子平衡结构并计算量子期望值。

title: Single-molecule cold chemistry: Isotopic branching ratios of the $\mathrm{H_2O^+ + HD}$ reaction at cryogenic temperatures
summary: Isotopic branching in ion-molecule reactions influences interstellar deuterium fractionation, yet its dynamics remain poorly understood for many important systems at astrophysically relevant temperatures. Here, we investigate H- and D-atom transfer in the $\mathrm{H_2O^+ + HD}$ reaction using single sympathetically cooled water ions in a cryogenic radiofrequency trap. Nondestructive identification of the products from 441 individual reaction events at a mean collision energy of 7 K reveals an $\mathrm{H_3O^+/H_2DO^+}$ product branching ratio of $1.50 \pm 0.15$ demonstrating a preferential H-atom transfer. The experiments are rationalized using quasi-classical-trajectory calculations which indicate a transition from direct dynamics at higher energies to a complex-mediated reaction under the present experimental conditions and point to an important role of intramolecular vibrational redistribution affecting the isotopic branching in this regime. The present results extend measurements into an astrochemically relevant energy regime and establish cryogenic single-ion chemistry as a new platform for resolving competing reaction pathways.

AI.tldr: 该文在7 K平均碰撞能下研究H2O+ + HD的H/D原子转移，发现H3O+/H2DO+产物支化比为1.50±0.15，表明H原子转移占优，并用QCT计算揭示复杂介导机制及分子内振动能量重分布对同位素支化的影响。
AI.motivation: 离子-分子反应中的同位素支化影响星际氘分馏，但许多重要体系在天体物理相关温度下的反应动力学仍不清楚。
AI.method: 利用低温射频阱中单个协同冷却的水离子，在平均碰撞能7 K下对441个单次反应事件进行无损产物识别，并结合准经典轨迹计算分析反应机理。
AI.result: 测得H3O+/H2DO+产物支化比为1.50±0.15，显示H原子转移优先；计算表明反应由高能区的直接动力学转变为当前条件下的复杂介导反应，并指出分子内振动能量重分布对该同位素支化的重要作用。
AI.conclusion: 研究将测量拓展至天体化学相关能量区间，并确立低温单离子化学作为解析竞争反应通道的新平台。

title: Anchored HLLD: A Riemann solver for a hypoelastic diffuse-interface model of compressible fluid-solid interaction
summary: We present an HLLD Riemann solver for a multicomponent hypoelastic diffuse-interface model of compressible fluid-solid interaction, with no separately computed interface and a deviatoric stress advanced by an objective hypoelastic rate law outside conservation-law form. The difficulty specific to this model is that the stress evolution is nonconservative and, unlike the familiar volume-fraction terms of Kapila-type models, cannot be left outside the Riemann solve once the shear waves are resolved. The shear coefficient $\rho(G+\tau_{xx})$ sets the impedance of the resolved shear waves and so belongs to their eigenstructure. Anchored HLLD carries it inside the solve by evaluating the HLLD fan twice at each face, anchored in turn to each adjacent cell-centered state, with every cell advancing from the flux anchored to its own state. HLL, HLLC, and anchored HLLD form a three-tier hierarchy of increasing wave resolution in one framework. We prove local structural properties: consistency at the reconstruction order, exact species-mass conservation, and tangential-momentum and energy drift vanishing under refinement at the reconstruction's face-jump order on smooth fields, with one-dimensional tests illustrating these structural properties and demonstrating first-order drift convergence on discontinuous fields. Across one-dimensional tests and two-dimensional production simulations in the open-source solver MFC, anchored HLLD resolves both the material contact and the shear waves, HLLC the contact alone, and HLL neither sharply. Where refinement studies are shown, anchored HLLD converges toward exact or semi-analytic solutions. A three-dimensional shock-ellipsoid interaction demonstrates the solver with all six stress components active.

AI.tldr: 提出用于多组分亚弹性扩散界面可压缩流固耦合模型的HLLD黎曼求解器，通过“锚定”策略将非保守偏应力演化中的剪切波阻抗纳入黎曼求解，并在MFC中实现HLL/HLLC/anchored HLLD三层波分辨率框架。
AI.motivation: 该模型中偏应力按客观亚弹性率演化且不写成守恒形式；与Kapila型体积分数项不同，一旦解析剪切波，应力演化不能留在黎曼求解之外，因为剪切系数ρ(G+τxx)决定剪切波阻抗并属于特征结构。
AI.method: 构造anchored HLLD：在每个面上分别以相邻单元中心状态为锚点计算HLLD扇两次，每个单元使用锚定于自身状态的通量推进；与HLL、HLLC构成统一框架下递增波分辨率的层级。证明重构阶一致性、组分质量精确守恒，以及光滑场上切向动量和能量漂移按面跳跃阶随细化消失。
AI.result: 一维测试验证结构性质并显示间断场上一阶漂移收敛；一维测试和MFC二维生产模拟中，anchored HLLD同时锐利解析材料接触和剪切波，HLLC仅解析接触，HLL均不锐利；细化研究显示anchored HLLD收敛到精确或半解析解；三维激波-椭球相互作用展示六个应力分量均活跃。
AI.conclusion: anchored HLLD为含非保守亚弹性应力的多组分扩散界面流固耦合提供了一种可解析剪切波且保持关键结构性质的黎曼求解方案，并在多维复杂问题中验证了有效性。

title: Coherent axion electrodynamics in OSIRIS: a counter-propagating axion-photon parametric instability
summary: We present a coherent axion-electrodynamics extension of the OSIRIS particle-in-cell code and use it to identify and benchmark a parametric axion-photon instability supported by two equal counter-propagating electromagnetic pumps. The module evolves a cell-centered axion field together with a separately stored first-order electromagnetic response on the native staggered OSIRIS grid. Re-examining the previously proposed strictly co-linear branch shows that it is removed when the axion-Maxwell equations are reduced consistently. A closely related standing-wave geometry, however, supports a distinct Floquet instability. We derive the coupled Floquet problem for an equal-amplitude counter-propagating pump pair and obtain a reduced analytic growth rate and cutoff for the dominant long-wavelength envelope branch. For an axion mass-to-pump-frequency ratio of 0.06 and a per-beam vector-potential amplitude of 0.3, simulations at coupling strengths of 0.60, 0.80, and 1.00 reproduce both the growth-rate spectrum and the coupling-dependent instability boundary. The reduced theory predicts envelope-mode cutoffs of 8.44, 10.80, and 13.23, while OSIRIS finds exponential growth through modes 8, 10, and 13, respectively, with the next resolved modes stable. The electromagnetic diagnostics additionally resolve exponentially growing sidebands at twice the pump wavenumber, while the zero-wavenumber electric component exhibits no sustained growth, as expected for the unstable Floquet eigenvector. The agreement provides an end-to-end benchmark of the coherent axion-electromagnetic coupling and demonstrates that parametric growth of the axion field is present in a two-beam pump geometry.

AI.tldr: 作者在OSIRIS粒子模拟代码中实现了相干轴子电动力学模块，并基准测试了由两束等幅对向传播电磁泵浦支持的参量轴子-光子不稳定性。
AI.motivation: 需要端到端验证轴子-电磁耦合的数值实现，并澄清此前提出的严格共线分支在一致约化下的有效性；同时研究对向双束泵浦几何中是否存在可解析刻画的参量不稳定性。
AI.method: 将中心网格存储的轴子场与交错OSIRIS网格上单独存储的一阶电磁响应耦合演化；一致约化轴子-Maxwell方程，证明严格共线分支被移除；针对等幅对向泵浦的驻波几何推导耦合Floquet问题，并给出主导长波包络分支的约化解析增长率与截止。
AI.result: 取轴子质量与泵浦频率比为0.06、单束矢量势幅度为0.3，在耦合强度0.60、0.80、1.00下模拟复现增长率谱和耦合相关不稳定边界；约化理论预测包络模截止为8.44、10.80、13.23，OSIRIS分别观察到模式8、10、13指数增长而下一可分辨模式稳定；电磁诊断还分辨出两倍泵浦波数处的指数增长边带，零波数电场分量无持续增长，符合不稳定Floquet本征矢预期。
AI.conclusion: 结果提供了相干轴子-电磁耦合的端到端基准，表明双束泵浦几何中确实存在轴子场的参量增长；严格共线分支在一致约化下消失，但相关驻波几何支持不同的Floquet不稳定性。

title: CoPiT: A conditional Position-induced Transformer for aerodynamic field prediction on unstructured meshes
summary: High-fidelity Reynolds-averaged Navier--Stokes (RANS) simulations remain a standard tool for aerodynamic analysis, yet each solve on an unstructured mesh is computationally expensive, making many-query tasks such as design exploration, optimization, and multi-condition evaluation costly. Neural operators provide mesh-flexible surrogates for mapping geometry and operating conditions to flow fields; however, in many existing architectures, global parameters such as the freestream state and design variables are concatenated with pointwise inputs, leaving their influence on intermediate features implicit. This paper proposes CoPiT, a \textbf{Co}nditional \textbf{P}osition-induced \textbf{T}ransformer that builds on the Position-induced Transformer (PiT) as its geometric backbone and injects a global condition vector through multi-stage feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM), thereby making parametric modulation explicit while preserving geometry-based attention weights. The model is evaluated on two-dimensional AirfRANS airfoil fields, including scarce-data and extrapolation regimes, and on three-dimensional BlendedNet++ blended-wing-body surfaces. On the AirfRANS full-data test set, CoPiT reduces surface and volume losses by approximately 54\% and 24\% relative to Transolver, respectively, and achieves the lowest overall normalized test MSE among the compared baselines on BlendedNet++. Matched ablations show that FiLM conditioning generally improves upon input concatenation, while the preferred placement is task-dependent. CoPiT thus provides a practical operator-learning surrogate for parametric aerodynamics on unstructured meshes.

AI.tldr: 提出CoPiT，一种条件位置诱导Transformer气动代理模型，用于非结构网格RANS流场快速预测，并通过多阶段FiLM显式注入全局条件。
AI.motivation: 高保真RANS仿真昂贵，设计探索、优化和多工况评估等多查询任务成本高；现有神经算子多将自由来流状态和设计变量与逐点输入拼接，导致全局参数对中间特征的影响是隐式的。
AI.method: 以Position-induced Transformer（PiT）为几何骨干，在多个阶段用特征级线性调制（FiLM）注入全局条件向量，使参数调制显式化，同时保留基于几何的注意力权重；在二维AirfRANS翼型场（含稀缺数据和 extrapolation 情形）及三维BlendedNet++翼身融合表面数据上评估。
AI.result: 在AirfRANS全数据测试集上，CoPiT相对Transolver将表面损失和体积损失分别降低约54%和24%；在BlendedNet++上取得对比基线中最低的整体归一化测试MSE；匹配消融表明FiLM条件注入通常优于输入拼接，但最佳注入位置依赖任务。
AI.conclusion: CoPiT为非结构网格上的参数化气动分析提供了一种实用且有效的算子学习代理模型。
